hindi: परित्याग का भय — छोड़ दिए जाने का गहरा डर
definition: a deep, lingering fear of being left behind by people one loves, usually rooted in an early loss and showing as clinginess or distrust
example: Every unanswered message triggered her abandonment issues, and she would text again just to be sure he was still there.

hindi: भाव-विरेचन — दबी हुई पीड़ा को दोबारा जीकर उसका बोझ उतारना
definition: the clinical release of buried emotion by reliving a painful memory and expressing the feeling that was blocked at the time
example: The abreaction came halfway through the session when she finally shouted at the empty chair standing in for her father.

hindi: तल्लीन — किसी काम या विचार में पूरी तरह लीन
definition: having one's whole attention taken up by something so that everything else is forgotten
example: Absorbed in the spreadsheet, he did not hear his name being called for lunch.

hindi: खट्टा-तीखा स्वभाव — कटु और चुभने वाली टिप्पणियों वाला
definition: sour and biting in manner or speech, with a caustic edge that makes ordinary comments feel like criticism
example: His acidulous review of the team lunch spot put everyone off suggesting new places.

hindi: आराधक — प्रेम भरी श्रद्धा से देखने वाला
definition: showing a warm devoted admiration that looks up at someone with love rather than fear
example: The puppy followed her around the kitchen with an adoring look.

hindi: विरोधात्मक — दूसरे को प्रतिद्वंद्वी मानकर पेश आना
definition: treating another person as an opponent who must be beaten rather than as a colleague to work alongside toward a shared goal
example: The meeting felt adversarial from the start, with the two departments defending their budgets instead of solving the problem.

hindi: अपमान — खुलेआम किया गया तिरस्कार
definition: an open insult or show of disrespect that wounds someone's pride and provokes resentment
example: Being asked to fetch coffee in front of the clients felt like a personal affront.

hindi: अपमानित रोष — खुले अनादर से आहत
definition: offended and angry because of an open insult or a show of disrespect to one's dignity
example: She looked affronted when the receptionist asked whether she could really afford the room.

hindi: व्यथित रोष — अन्याय झेलने की नाराज़गी
definition: feeling resentful and wronged because of unfair treatment, anger mixed with a sense of injury
example: The aggrieved tenants wrote to the council after the heating was left broken for a month.

hindi: उत्सुक — आश्चर्य और जिज्ञासा से उत्तेजित
definition: eagerly excited and wide-eyed with curiosity to hear or see what happens next
example: The kids were agog when their uncle started pulling coins from behind their ears at dinner.

hindi: भाव-अनभिज्ञता — अपनी भावनाओं को पहचानने या कहने में कठिनाई
definition: difficulty identifying and describing your own emotions, so feelings register only as vague physical discomfort
example: His alexithymia meant that when his partner asked how he felt about moving, he honestly could not say.

hindi: परिवेश — किसी स्थान का सुखद भावनात्मक वातावरण
definition: the gentle, pervasive mood of a place created by its light, sound and company, usually meant to be pleasant
example: The cafe had an ambience that made the whole table linger long after the coffee was finished.

hindi: आत्मसम्मान की नाज़ुक भावना — दूसरों की नज़र में अपनी छवि का गर्व
definition: a sensitive self-esteem that depends on how others see you, easily wounded by any slight to your image
example: His amour-propre was bruised when the client forgot his name during the presentation.

hindi: उत्तेजना से भरा — भीतर बिजली सी उमंग
definition: buzzing with energetic excitement and ready to begin, an American word for adrenaline-charged enthusiasm before an event
example: He was so amped before the race that he could not sit still on the bus.

hindi: ऊर्जाहीनता — कोई काम करने की ताकत का अभाव
definition: in psychiatry, a marked lack of energy and drive so that even ordinary activities feel beyond reach, often part of depression
example: The doctor asked about anergia when he described lying awake yet unable to get up and shower.

hindi: मूल्यहीनता की भावना — नियमों और उद्देश्य से कट जाने की बेचैनी
definition: a feeling of purposelessness and drift when the values and rules that once guided you seem to have collapsed
example: After the company dropped every tradition in the restructure, a quiet anomie spread through the older staff.

hindi: चिंताग्रस्त लगाव — छोड़ दिए जाने के डर से रिश्ते में लगातार आश्वासन खोजना
definition: a pattern of clinging closeness in relationships, driven by a constant fear of being abandoned and a need for reassurance
example: His anxious attachment showed when three unanswered texts on a Tuesday afternoon had him drafting a breakup speech.

hindi: कंपित — उत्तेजना या भय से काँपता हुआ
definition: trembling all over with excitement, nervousness or eager anticipation, shaking before something happens
example: She was aquiver as the envelope with the exam results came through the letterbox.

hindi: बहसबाज़ — हर बात पर विवाद करने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: fond of disputing and disagreeing, turning ordinary conversations into debates nobody asked for
example: Her argumentative uncle contested even the weather forecast at Sunday lunch.

hindi: उत्तेजना — शरीर और मन में जागी हुई कामेच्छा या तीव्र उत्तेजना
definition: the state of being physically and emotionally stirred by desire, the body responding before thought
example: She felt a flush of arousal when his hand rested on the small of her back in the crowded lift.

hindi: उखड़ा-बदमिज़ाज — रूखी चिड़चिड़ी अशिष्टता
definition: bad-tempered and rudely uncooperative, a British word for someone being difficult and irritable without good reason
example: The bouncer got arsey when we asked what time the doors opened.

hindi: उदास और चिड़चिड़ा — विषाद और खीझ से भरा स्वभाव
definition: gloomy and bad-tempered at the same time, as though sadness has soured into sourness
example: By the third delayed train of the week he had turned thoroughly atrabilious.

hindi: ध्यानाकर्षक — हर हाल में लोगों की नज़र अपनी ओर चाहने वाला
definition: a person who craves notice and approval so much that they behave dramatically or provocatively to get it
example: The attention seeker in the meeting kept interrupting with stories about his weekend.

hindi: आकर्षण — किसी व्यक्ति की ओर खिंचाव और उसके करीब रहने की चाह
definition: the pull you feel toward someone that makes you want to be near them, whether romantic or simply magnetic
example: She tried to ignore the attraction she felt toward her new colleague and focused on the spreadsheet.

hindi: प्रेरणा का अभाव — कार्य शुरू करने की इच्छा न होना
definition: a marked lack of motivation to begin or carry through purposeful activities, even ones you know matter
example: Avolition kept him from replying to the emails piling up, not laziness but a total absence of drive.

hindi: विस्मयकारी — श्रद्धा और आश्चर्य से भर देने वाला
definition: filling you with reverent wonder and a humbling sense of your own smallness before something vast or magnificent
example: The awe-inspiring drone footage of the glacier made the whole meeting forget the agenda.

hindi: बकबक करना — उत्तेजना या घबराहट में बिना रुके बोलना
definition: to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish or excited way, often because nerves or joy have taken over
example: She babbled happily about the new flat to anyone who would listen at the party.

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा और गुस्सैल — आसानी से नाराज़ होने वाला
definition: easily angered and disagreeable, either by nature or because of a passing foul mood
example: The bad-tempered driver leaned on the horn the moment the light turned green.

hindi: उलझन — किसी को पूरी तरह चकरा देना
definition: to confuse someone completely so that they feel frustrated at being unable to understand
example: The new ticket machine baffled every commuter on the platform.

hindi: ठिठकना — संदेह या डर से अचानक रुक जाना
definition: to stop short and refuse to proceed because sudden doubt or unease makes the next step feel wrong
example: He balked at signing when he saw the cancellation fee in the fine print.

hindi: धुंध में घिरा मन — सोच का धुंधला और सुस्त हो जाना
definition: having a mind so clouded and sluggish that thinking, remembering and concentrating all feel harder than usual
example: By the afternoon meeting she was so befogged she forgot the name of her own project.

hindi: तुच्छ ठहराना — किसी की उपलब्धि को छोटा दिखाना
definition: to make someone or their achievement seem small and unimportant, showing contempt by refusing to grant it value
example: Every time she mentioned her promotion, her brother found a way to belittle it as luck.

hindi: पेट से निकली हँसी — गहरी, बेकाबू, पूरे शरीर को हिला देने वाली हँसी
definition: a deep, loud, unrestrained laugh that seems to come from your stomach and shakes your whole body
example: The clip of the cat falling off the shelf got a genuine belly laugh out of everyone at the table.

hindi: दुःख जताना — किसी बात पर अफसोस प्रकट करना
definition: to complain sorrowfully about something, expressing regret or disappointment over it
example: The commuters bemoaned the cancelled trains in a long thread of unhappy messages.

hindi: कट्टरता — अपने से अलग लोगों के प्रति अंधा द्वेष
definition: stubborn, unreasoning hatred and intolerance toward people of a different group or belief, refusing to see them as equals
example: The comments under the video were full of bigotry dressed up as jokes.

hindi: लुभावनी बातें — मनाने के लिए की गई मधुर चापलूसी
definition: a flattering, coaxing remark designed to charm someone into doing what you want, honeyed rather than honest
example: No amount of blandishment could get the barista to open ten minutes early.

hindi: उदासीन — भोगे हुए सुख से ऊबा और निर्विकार
definition: unimpressed and casually indifferent toward things that would excite others because you feel you have already seen it all
example: He was so blasé about the free concert tickets that he forgot to pick them up.

hindi: मिमियाना — कमज़ोर, दयनीय स्वर में शिकायत करना
definition: to complain in a weak, plaintive, sheep-like voice that invites little sympathy
example: He bleated that the exam was unfair while everyone else packed up their bags.

hindi: परमानंद — पूर्ण और शांत सुख की अवस्था
definition: a state of complete and untroubled happiness so perfect that nothing seems to be missing
example: Lying in the hammock with a cold drink and no phone signal was pure bliss.

hindi: रक्त जमा देने वाला — अत्यंत भयानक और दहलाने वाला
definition: so terrifying that it seems to freeze the blood, especially describing a scream or sudden sound
example: A bloodcurdling shriek from the garden turned out to be the neighbours' fox.

hindi: रक्तपिपासु — हिंसा और खून की लालसा
definition: eager for violence and cruelty, taking pleasure in seeing others hurt or killed
example: The comments section turned bloodthirsty the moment the referee's mistake was replayed.

hindi: हठी-विरोधी — दुराग्रह भरी जिद
definition: perversely stubborn and deliberately obstructive, refusing to cooperate just to be difficult, a British streak of contrariness
example: He was too bloody-minded to take the shortcut once his sister had suggested it.

hindi: बिसूरना — बच्चों की तरह ज़ोर से और बेबसी में रोना
definition: to cry noisily and without restraint, in a childish way that you may later feel embarrassed about
example: I blubbed all the way through the final episode and had to hide my face in a cushion.

hindi: फूट-फूटकर रोना — बेतरतीब, ज़ोर से बिलखना
definition: to weep noisily and messily, sobbing in a way that seems childish or lacking self-control
example: By the end of the film the whole row was blubbering into their popcorn.

hindi: उदासी की लहर — हल्की, बेवजह उदास मनोदशा
definition: a spell of low spirits and mild sadness that arrives without a clear cause and usually passes
example: She gets the blues every Sunday evening when the weekend shrinks to nothing.

hindi: हुल्लड़ भरा — शोरगुल वाला उल्लास
definition: noisy, energetic and cheerfully rowdy, with a loudness that comes from good spirits rather than anger
example: The boisterous birthday crowd at the next table sang three rounds of the same song.

hindi: भीतर बंद की हुई — बाहर न आने दी गई दबाई हुई भावना
definition: describing emotions deliberately kept inside and never expressed, sealed away rather than shared
example: His bottled-up grief finally surfaced when a colleague asked how his father was doing.

hindi: चमचागिरी करना — ऊपर वालों की खुशामद में लगे रहना
definition: to flatter and fawn over a person in authority so obviously that everyone else can see the motive
example: He brown-nosed the new director so hard at lunch that his colleagues stopped eating to watch.

hindi: ऊबा-चिढ़ा — बेकार के इंतज़ार से खिन्न
definition: tired and mildly annoyed, usually from boredom or endless waiting, a British irritation that turned dull and heavy
example: By the third delay announcement the passengers were thoroughly browned off.

hindi: थकान से चुका हुआ — लंबे तनाव के बाद उत्साह और ऊर्जा खो चुका
definition: emotionally emptied by long, unrelieved stress, so that work once cared about now feels pointless and draining
example: After two years of night shifts she admitted she was burnt out and could not face another rota.

hindi: बंद-सधा — भावनाओं को कसकर छिपाए रखने वाला औपचारिक स्वभाव
definition: emotionally reserved and formal, keeping feelings tightly fastened away behind a correct careful manner
example: Even at the leaving party the buttoned-up accountant never loosened his tie or his smile.

hindi: मज़ा किरकिरा करने वाला — उत्साह ठंडा कर देने वाली बात
definition: something or someone that abruptly spoils a happy, excited mood and leaves the enjoyment deflated
example: Mentioning Monday's audit at the Friday drinks was a total buzzkill.

hindi: संवेदनहीन — दूसरों के दुख के प्रति कठोर और बेपरवाह
definition: showing a hardened indifference to the suffering or feelings of other people, without any softening of sympathy
example: It felt callous when the manager announced the cuts and then asked who wanted cake.

hindi: कर दिखाने का हौसला — हर चुनौती को संभव मानने वाला आत्मविश्वासी रवैया
definition: confidently willing and eager to tackle any problem, sure that a way forward can be found
example: Her can-do attitude meant the leaking dishwasher became a weekend project instead of a complaint.

hindi: झगड़ालू चिड़चिड़ापन — बात-बात पर बहस करने वाला
definition: bad-tempered and argumentative by habit, quick to quarrel over small things and hard to please
example: The cantankerous old neighbour complained about the noise of children playing every single afternoon.

hindi: स्नेह से सहलाना — कोमल स्पर्श से प्रेम प्रकट करना
definition: to touch or stroke someone gently and slowly as a way of showing tender affection
example: She caressed the sleeping toddler's hair while the rest of the house argued about dinner.

hindi: चिंता से थका — लंबी चिंताओं से घिसा हुआ
definition: showing the marks of long worry and sorrow, a tired sadness worn into the face over years
example: The careworn nurse smiled at the end of the double shift, but her eyes stayed tired.

hindi: भावनात्मक निवेश — किसी व्यक्ति, वस्तु या विचार पर मनोवेग का केंद्रित होना
definition: the concentration of emotional energy on a person, object or idea, psychology's term for investing feeling
example: His cathexis on the old family car was so strong that selling it felt like losing a relative.

hindi: लापरवाह घमंड वाला — गंभीर बातों को हल्के में लेने वाला
definition: showing a proud, offhand lack of concern about something serious, as though it were beneath your attention
example: Her cavalier shrug when the backup failed made the rest of the team more worried, not less.

hindi: जश्न मनाने वाला — सफलता की खुशी में किया गया
definition: done in a mood of shared gladness to mark a success or special occasion
example: They ordered celebratory pizza the moment the last bug was closed.

hindi: आकर्षित करना — सुखद व्यवहार से मन जीत लेना
definition: to delight someone and win their affection through warmth, wit and a pleasant manner
example: The new intern charmed the entire floor within a week with her easy laugh.

hindi: ठगा हुआ — अपने हक़ से वंचित होने की कड़वाहट
definition: bitter at being denied something you fairly deserved, whether through dishonesty or plain unfairness
example: She felt cheated when the promotion went to the colleague who had joined six months after her.

hindi: हल्की डांट — स्नेहपूर्ण किन्तु असंतुष्ट फटकार
definition: to scold someone mildly, expressing disappointment in a gentle way that carries more concern than anger
example: She chided her husband for skipping lunch again when the doctor had told him not to.

hindi: रोंगटे खड़े करने वाला — ठंडे भय से भर देने वाला
definition: producing a cold, creeping sense of fear because of how calm or deliberate a threat seems
example: The chilling voicemail simply said he knew where she parked.

hindi: सिहरन — भावना से उपजी ठंडी कंपकंपी
definition: a sudden shiver through the body caused by a powerful emotional moment rather than cold
example: She got chills when the old recording of her mother's voice started playing.

hindi: चुस्त-प्रसन्न — खुश और फुर्तीला
definition: cheerful and lively in a brisk, energetic way, often surprisingly so given the hour or situation
example: She was oddly chipper for someone who had just come off a red-eye flight.

hindi: गला रुंधा हुआ — भावुकता से आवाज़ अटकी हुई
definition: unable to speak steadily because a sudden rush of tender emotion has tightened the throat
example: He got choked up reading the thank-you notes the students had slipped under his door.

hindi: खिलखिलाना — खुशी से दबी हुई हँसी हँसना
definition: to give a breathy, gleeful laugh that mixes a chuckle with a snort of satisfaction
example: She chortled at the typo in the client email before quietly fixing it.

hindi: घनिष्ठ मित्रता — खुली और आत्मीय दोस्ताना निकटता
definition: friendly and intimate in an easy, informal way, sometimes more than the situation calls for
example: The new client got chummy fast, sending memes to the group chat by lunchtime.

hindi: सोच-समझकर चलने वाला — जोखिम से बचने की सावधानी
definition: thinking carefully about the consequences before speaking or acting, unwilling to take risks with people you do not know well
example: She was circumspect about what she posted in the team channel once she learned the client could read it.

hindi: गुटपरस्त — अपने गुट से बाहर के लोगों को दूर रखने वाला
definition: closely loyal to your own group and cool or suspicious toward anyone outside it
example: The founders were clannish, lunching together every day and never inviting the newer staff.

hindi: बंद जगह का भय — तंग या घिरी हुई जगहों से होने वाली घबराहट
definition: an intense fear of being shut in small or enclosed spaces, bringing on panic and a need to escape
example: His claustrophobia made the packed lift at the conference unbearable.

hindi: स्पष्ट-बुद्धि — घबराहट या भावना से धुंधलाए बिना सोचने वाला
definition: thinking calmly and lucidly, especially under pressure, with judgement unclouded by panic, anger or wishful hope
example: The most clearheaded person in the outage was the intern who simply asked what had changed at four o'clock.

hindi: चिपकू लगाव — स्नेह में किसी से इतना जुड़ना कि उसे घुटन होने लगे
definition: needing someone's attention and closeness so much that your affection becomes suffocating and dependent
example: He worried he was being clingy when he texted to ask why she had not replied within ten minutes.

hindi: सह-निर्भरता — किसी की ज़रूरतों में डूबकर अपनी पहचान खो देना
definition: an unhealthy emotional reliance on another person, in which your worth depends on being needed and rescuing them
example: She recognised the codependency when she cancelled her own job interview to fix her brother's overdraft again.

hindi: ठंडे दिल का — बिना भावना के क्रूरता
definition: deliberately cruel without any feeling or heat of passion, acting with calm indifference to suffering
example: The coldblooded way she fired him over a video call while eating lunch shocked the team.

hindi: सामूहिक आघात — पूरे समुदाय पर पड़ा गहरा मानसिक घाव
definition: the lasting shared shock and sorrow carried by a whole community after a disaster or atrocity that struck all of them at once
example: Years after the flood, the town's collective trauma still surfaced whenever the river rose.

hindi: सहकर्मी-भाव — सहयोगियों के बीच आदरपूर्ण मित्रता
definition: the warm, respectful fellow feeling among colleagues who treat each other as equals and share responsibility willingly
example: What she missed most after leaving the department was the collegiality of the Friday reviews.

hindi: अवनति की निराशा — ऊँचाई से नीचे आने का दुखद अहसास
definition: a disappointing fall from a better position or from a high mood, felt as a humbling drop
example: Going back to the open-plan desk after a week presenting abroad was quite a comedown.

hindi: जटिल शोक — जो शोक समय के साथ भी हल्का न हो
definition: grief that stays intense for far longer than usual and blocks a person from returning to ordinary life
example: Two years after her husband died the counsellor gently named it complicated grief.

hindi: धैर्य — दबाव में भी मन का शांत और संयत बने रहना
definition: the settled calmness that keeps a person steady and unshaken when a situation pushes them toward panic or anger
example: She answered every hostile question at the town hall meeting without once losing her composure.

hindi: सहचरता — साझा काम या संघर्ष से बना अपनापन
definition: the warm bond of loyalty and trust between people who have faced hard work or hardship side by side
example: The comradeship of the launch week, with everyone sleeping under desks, outlasted the product itself.

hindi: चिंता भरी परवाह — किसी की भलाई के लिए स्नेहपूर्ण फ़िक्र
definition: a caring worry about someone's wellbeing that comes from affection rather than fear for yourself
example: Her concern showed when she quietly slipped a packed lunch into her brother's bag before his interview.

hindi: अंतर्द्वंद्व में — परस्पर विरोधी भावनाओं का एक साथ होना
definition: having contradictory feelings about something so that no choice feels fully right
example: She was conflicted about attending the reunion she had once sworn to skip.

hindi: स्तब्ध और भ्रमित — अपेक्षा उलट जाने से हैरान
definition: surprised and confused because something has gone against every expectation you held
example: The confounded coach watched his weakest player score three goals in the final.

hindi: जुड़ाव — दूसरों से भावनात्मक रूप से बंधे होने का भाव
definition: the warm feeling of being emotionally linked to other people and part of something larger than yourself
example: The weekly call with old university friends gave him a connectedness that the office never had.

hindi: अंतरात्मा से पीड़ित — दोष की गहरी कचोट में
definition: suddenly and sharply troubled by a sense of wrongdoing, as if your conscience had struck a blow
example: Conscience-stricken, he went back to the shop to pay for the pen he had pocketed.

hindi: तुच्छ और तिरस्कार योग्य — जिसका आदर करना असंभव हो
definition: deserving scorn because the conduct is petty, cowardly or dishonest rather than merely wrong
example: Blaming the intern for a mistake he had made himself was contemptible, and the team lost respect for him.

hindi: गुटरगूँ करना — प्यार और लाड़ भरे कोमल मधुर स्वर में बोलना
definition: to speak in a soft, gentle, murmuring voice full of affection or admiration, as people do over a baby
example: The whole family cooed over the puppy as it fell asleep in the shoebox.

hindi: नखरीली — चंचल इशारों से ध्यान और प्रशंसा खींचने वाली
definition: playfully flirtatious in a teasing way, inviting attention while keeping the other person guessing
example: She gave him a coquettish glance across the bar and then went back to her friends as if nothing had happened.

hindi: अतिशय लाड़ करना — किसी को स्नेह से हर कठिनाई से बचाकर रखना
definition: to care for someone with such protective tenderness that you shield them from every discomfort, hardship and difficulty
example: His aunt cosseted him through the whole flu, refilling his soup before the bowl was even empty.

hindi: आरामदेह — गर्माहट और अपनेपन भरा सुकून
definition: giving a snug feeling of warmth, safety and contentment in a small familiar setting
example: With the rain outside and soup on the stove the tiny kitchen felt wonderfully cosy.

hindi: लालसा करना — दूसरे की चीज़ पाने की तीव्र और बेचैन इच्छा रखना
definition: to want something that belongs to someone else so badly that the wanting eats at you
example: She coveted her colleague's corner desk with the window and found herself resenting his early arrivals.

hindi: सांस्कृतिक आघात — नई जगह के अपरिचित रीति-रिवाज़ों से घबराहट
definition: the disoriented, anxious feeling of arriving somewhere whose customs, food and manners are unfamiliar, before one learns to read them
example: The first week in Tokyo was pure culture shock, and she stood frozen at the ticket machine while commuters flowed around her.

hindi: खड़ूस — चिड़चिड़ा बूढ़ा व्यक्ति
definition: a bad-tempered, surly person who grumbles about everything and treats everyone with sour suspicion
example: The office curmudgeon muttered about the new coffee machine for the whole of Monday.

hindi: अड़ियल और खफ़ा — जानबूझकर उलटा चलने वाला
definition: stubbornly awkward and uncooperative out of ill temper, refusing to go along with things simply to be difficult
example: Too cussed to admit the shortcut was wrong, he drove them twenty minutes out of the way.

hindi: सुरक्षित आलिंगन — गले लगाकर सुरक्षा और अपनापन देने वाली गर्माहट
definition: a warm sheltering cuddle that makes you feel safe and cared for, more comfort than embrace
example: After the exam results came in, all she wanted was a cwtch from her mum and a cup of tea.

hindi: चकाचौंध — चमक या प्रतिभा से अभिभूत
definition: so impressed and overwhelmed by brilliance or splendour that you cannot judge it clearly or critically
example: The dazzled interns hung on every word of the founder's keynote.

hindi: भावशून्य आँखों वाला — नज़र में कोई जीवन या भाव न होना
definition: having eyes that show no feeling or interest, giving an impression of inner emptiness
example: The dead-eyed cashier scanned the items without once looking up or answering her greeting.

hindi: मानसिक संतुलन का टूटना — सहने की क्षमता का ढह जाना
definition: the clinical collapse of someone's ability to cope, when the defences that kept distress in check give way under strain
example: The ward doctor worried about decompensation when the exams, the breakup and the eviction landed in the same fortnight.

hindi: दबाव उतारना — तनाव के बाद मन को हल्का करना
definition: to release the pressure of a stressful stretch by taking quiet time until the mind returns to calm
example: After the product launch, the whole team took Friday off just to decompress.

hindi: व्यक्तित्व-विलोप — भीड़ में खुद को खोकर संकोच त्याग देना
definition: the loss of your sense of being an individual within a crowd, which loosens restraint and lets people act as they never would alone
example: Behind an anonymous username, deindividuation turned a polite accountant into the forum's cruellest commenter.

hindi: विलंबित तृप्ति — बड़े सुख के लिए छोटा सुख टालना
definition: the deeper satisfaction of waiting for a bigger reward instead of grabbing the pleasure available now, self-control that pays off later
example: Saving the last episode for Friday night was her small act of delayed gratification.

hindi: उन्मत्त हर्ष — खुशी से बेसुध और बेकाबू
definition: wildly and almost incoherently excited, with happiness so overwhelming that you lose your usual composure and sense
example: The interns were delirious when the client renewed the contract on the spot.

hindi: राक्षस ठहराना — किसी को पूरी तरह बुरा बताकर घृणा फैलाना
definition: to portray a person or group as thoroughly evil so that others come to fear and hate them without question
example: The neighbourhood forum quickly demonized the new landlord before anyone had even met him.

hindi: हतोत्साहित करना — आत्मविश्वास और उत्साह तोड़ देना
definition: to destroy someone's confidence and spirit, leaving them discouraged and unwilling to keep trying
example: The constant last-minute changes demoralized the whole design team.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — आत्मविश्वास और हौसला खो चुका
definition: having lost confidence and hope after setbacks or criticism, with little will to continue
example: The team was demoralized after the client rejected the design for the fourth time.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — जिसकी काम करने की इच्छा छीन ली गई हो
definition: having lost the drive and enthusiasm you once had for something, usually because setbacks or poor treatment drained it away
example: The team was demotivated after their proposal was ignored for the third time in a row.

hindi: रिक्त-थका — मानो अंदर की सारी ऊर्जा निकल गई हो
definition: feeling drained of inner reserves of energy and patience, as if there is nothing left to give
example: By the end of the family visit he was depleted and just wanted silence.

hindi: खेद प्रकट करना — गहरे दुख से निंदा करना
definition: to feel and express strong disapproval mixed with sorrow about something you find shameful
example: The whole team deplored the way the layoffs were announced by group email.

hindi: यथार्थ-विलगन — दुनिया का अवास्तविक या स्वप्न जैसा लगना
definition: the unsettling feeling that the world around you is unreal, foggy or dreamlike, often during severe anxiety
example: The derealization hit in the supermarket and the bright aisles looked like a film set.

hindi: बेफ़िक्र — परिणामों की परवाह किए बिना मौज में
definition: cheerfully reckless and carefree, enjoying the moment with a grin and no thought for what might go wrong
example: He drove the hire car through the mountain pass with a devil-may-care whoop at every hairpin.

hindi: छोटा महसूस कराना — किसी के महत्व को घटाकर आहत करना
definition: to make someone feel smaller and less worthy than they are, quietly shrinking their sense of their own value
example: Every time he corrected her in front of guests, she felt diminished a little more.

hindi: अप्रिय स्वभाव — रूखा, बदमिज़ाज और साथ में असुखद
definition: unpleasant in temper and manner, hard to like and quick to sour the mood around you
example: The disagreeable passenger complained about the window, the aisle and finally the sky.

hindi: नैतिक अस्वीकृति — सार्वजनिक निंदा का भाव
definition: strong moral disapproval expressed openly, a formal word for the collective frown a community turns on bad conduct
example: The councillor faced the disapprobation of the whole village after the planning scandal came to light.

hindi: आकर्षण भंग — जादू उतर जाने की मंद उदासी
definition: a quiet fading of the delight or admiration you once felt, leaving mild sadness in its place
example: His disenchantment with the city started the winter the rent went up again.

hindi: मोहभंग — सुखद भ्रम को तोड़कर निराश करना
definition: to cause someone a sorrowful disappointment by showing that something they believed in was never as good as they thought
example: Working at the charity's head office disillusioned him about how the donations were spent.

hindi: मोहभंग — भ्रम टूटने की उदासी
definition: the sad disappointment of discovering that something believed in was never as good as it seemed
example: His disillusionment with the startup grew once he saw how the founders treated the interns.

hindi: अरुचि — किसी चीज़ में ध्यान या परवाह का अभाव
definition: a plain lack of interest or concern about something, shown as flat inattention rather than active dislike
example: She scrolled past the invitation with total disinterest and went back to her podcast.

hindi: असहयोगी-रूखा — छोटी मदद भी करने से मुँह फेर लेने वाला
definition: unwilling to do even small favours, refusing help in a cold ungenerous way that makes everything harder
example: The disobliging clerk would not lend a pen even when the queue behind me sighed.

hindi: दिशाहीन — दिमाग ठिकाने न होना
definition: confused and unsteady, unable to tell direction, time or what is going on around you
example: The disoriented passenger wandered the airport looking for a gate that had been changed twice.

hindi: निर्लिप्तता — भावनाओं से अछूती, तटस्थ शांति
definition: a calm, detached state of mind free from strong feeling or personal bias, valued when a fair judgement is needed
example: She reviewed her own startup's failure with a dispassion that unsettled the interviewer.

hindi: अविश्वास — किसी की नीयत पर भरोसा न होना
definition: the firm feeling that someone cannot be relied on to be honest, usually based on something they have already done
example: Her distrust of the new landlord began the day he changed the rent figure between the phone call and the contract.

hindi: असमंजस में डोलना — घबराहट में निर्णय न ले पाना
definition: to hesitate nervously and waver between choices, unable to decide because of unease about getting it wrong
example: He dithered at the ticket machine so long that the train pulled out without him.

hindi: दबंग — दूसरों पर रोब जमाने वाला
definition: insisting on having your own way over other people through force of personality rather than agreement
example: The domineering team lead shot down every idea in the meeting before anyone had finished explaining it.

hindi: संशयग्रस्त — यह होगा या सच है, इस पर अनिश्चित और शंकित
definition: unsure whether something is true or will happen, leaning toward thinking it will not
example: She was doubtful that the delivery would arrive before the party, and quietly ordered a backup cake.

hindi: रूखा-गंभीर — कठोर और उदास स्वभाव
definition: stern, gloomy and unsmiling by temperament, a hard sadness that never softens into warmth
example: The dour manager greeted the birthday cake with a nod and went back to his spreadsheet.

hindi: व्यावहारिक — बिना दिखावे या नाटक के सहज और यथार्थवादी
definition: practical, unpretentious and calmly realistic in outlook, never swept up by drama or grand feeling
example: The down-to-earth surgeon explained the risks over a cup of canteen tea without a hint of theatre.

hindi: दबे-कुचले — लंबे दबाव से हताश और हारे हुए
definition: oppressed and beaten down for so long that hope of anything better has faded
example: The downtrodden warehouse staff had stopped complaining about the broken heating years ago.

hindi: नाटकबाज़ — छोटी बात को भावनात्मक तमाशा बना देने वाला
definition: a person who reacts to minor troubles with exaggerated, theatrical emotion to draw attention
example: The drama queen of the group chat declared her whole week ruined by one late bus.

hindi: भावनात्मक बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना — घटना को अधिक तीव्र या दुखद बनाना
definition: to describe or react to an event with more emotional intensity than the event really deserves
example: She tends to dramatize every delayed train into a personal ordeal.

hindi: भ्रमणोन्माद — कहीं भी चले जाने की अनियंत्रित बेचैनी
definition: an uncontrollable restless urge to wander or travel away, the old psychiatric name for compulsive roaming
example: He joked that his dromomania kicked in every time he sat at his desk for more than a week.

hindi: मुरझाना — थकान या उदासी से ढीला पड़ जाना
definition: to sag or hang down limply as energy and spirits drain away from tiredness or sadness
example: Her shoulders drooped as the last train pulled out without her.

hindi: बेवकूफ़ बनाया गया — धोखे में आकर लज्जित
definition: feeling foolish and cheated after realising you were tricked into believing or doing something
example: She felt duped when the free trial she had signed up for quietly charged her card for a full year.

hindi: भावनात्मक अनियंत्रण — भावनाओं को संभालने और शांत करने में असमर्थता
definition: the clinical inability to manage the intensity of an emotion, so that anger or distress climbs far past what the situation warrants and stays there
example: The counsellor explained that his rage over a cancelled train was dysregulation rather than a bad temper.

hindi: सहज स्वभाव — शांत, तनावमुक्त और सहनशील
definition: relaxed, tolerant and not easily upset, taking life at a calm and cheerful pace
example: The easygoing landlord said the rent could wait until after the long weekend.

hindi: धृष्टता — बेशर्म ढिठाई और गुस्ताखी
definition: shameless boldness that offends by treating decent limits as though they simply do not apply
example: He had the effrontery to ask for a reference from the manager he had publicly blamed.

hindi: भावनाओं का उमड़ना — बेकाबू भावनात्मक बहाव
definition: an unrestrained outpouring of feeling in speech or writing that flows without check
example: The retirement card became an effusion of memories and tearful wishes.

hindi: आत्मकेंद्रित — सब कुछ अपने ही नज़रिए से देखने वाला
definition: seeing everything from your own point of view and treating your own needs as the centre of every situation, without necessarily boasting
example: He was so egocentric that he rescheduled the whole trip around his gym class without asking anyone else.

hindi: अहं-उन्माद — अपने बारे में सनक की हद तक जुनून
definition: an extreme, almost unhinged obsession with yourself and your own importance, so total that other people barely register as real
example: His egomania was such that he rewrote the team's shared slides to make every win sound like his alone.

hindi: भावनात्मक श्रम — काम के लिए भावनाएँ छिपाने या दिखाने की मेहनत
definition: the tiring effort of managing one's own feelings and soothing other people's as an unpaid part of a job or relationship
example: The receptionist smiled through a full shift of angry callers, and the emotional labour left her more drained than any spreadsheet.

hindi: भावनात्मक सुन्नता — कुछ भी महसूस न कर पाने की स्थिति
definition: a state of feeling nothing where sorrow or gladness should be, often a shield the mind raises after too much pain
example: When the layoff email finally arrived he felt only an emotional numbness and went back to his spreadsheet.

hindi: भावनात्मक स्थिरता — मनोदशा में उतार-चढ़ाव कम, मन शांत और स्थिर
definition: the temperament trait of staying even and calm across good days and bad, with few sharp mood swings and a quick return to balance after upset
example: Her emotional stability made her the person everyone called when a project was collapsing at midnight.

hindi: भावुकतावाद — तर्क पर भावना की अतिशयता
definition: a tendency to let feeling dominate over reason and to display emotion freely
example: The debate sank into emotionalism once the budget cuts were mentioned.

hindi: सशक्त बनाने वाला — भीतर शक्ति और आत्मविश्वास जगाने वाला
definition: giving a surge of confidence and strength that makes you feel capable of taking control of your own life
example: She found the memoir so empowering that she finally asked for the promotion the next morning.

hindi: ऊर्जावान — भरपूर ताकत और सक्रियता से भरा हुआ
definition: full of active physical and mental energy, ready to move and work hard without seeming to tire
example: The most energetic person in the group chat was already planning the next hike before we had finished the first.

hindi: ऊर्जा भरना — उत्साह और जोश जगाना
definition: to fill someone with fresh enthusiasm and vigour so they feel ready and eager to begin working
example: The customer feedback session energized the design team for the rest of the sprint.

hindi: शक्तिहीन करना — जोश और ऊर्जा को निचोड़ लेना
definition: to drain someone of energy and vitality until they feel weak, limp, and unable to care
example: The humid afternoon and the endless webinar combined to enervate everyone on the call.

hindi: लुभाना — कुछ आकर्षक दिखाकर खींचना
definition: to attract and tempt someone toward something by offering a glimpse of what is appealing or interesting
example: The smell of fresh bread was enough to entice the whole office downstairs.

hindi: रसिक — उत्तम भोजन और सुख का पारखी
definition: devoted to refined pleasure, especially good food and drink, enjoying each sensation slowly and with discriminating taste
example: Their epicurean weekends revolved around farmers' markets and a slow three-hour lunch.

hindi: पलायनवाद — कठोर वास्तविकता से भागकर कल्पना या मनोरंजन में शरण लेना
definition: the urge to seek relief from unpleasant reality by retreating into fantasy or entertainment
example: Binge-watching the whole series in one weekend was pure escapism after the layoffs.

hindi: कठोर मांग वाला — ऊँचे मानकों पर सख्ती से जोर देने वाला
definition: demanding rigorous standards from yourself and others, with a stern impatience for anything careless or half-finished
example: The exacting head chef sent the plate back over a single smear on the rim.

hindi: उत्तेजनशील — छोटी सी बात पर आसानी से उत्साहित या उत्तेजित हो जाने वाला
definition: easily thrown into eager excitement by small things, quick to become worked up and enthusiastic
example: The puppy was so excitable that the sound of car keys sent it spinning in circles by the door.

hindi: चिल्ला उठना — आश्चर्य, हर्ष या पीड़ा में अचानक बोल पड़ना
definition: to cry out suddenly and loudly because surprise, delight, pain or another strong feeling has caught you unprepared
example: She exclaimed in delight when she spotted her old teacher across the supermarket.

hindi: थकावट — शरीर और मन की पूरी ऊर्जा चुक जाना
definition: a state of complete tiredness in body and mind after prolonged effort or strain
example: The exhaustion after the marathon shift left her staring blankly at the fridge.

hindi: प्रदर्शनप्रियता — ध्यान खींचने के लिए खुद को दिखाने की लालसा
definition: a compulsive desire to attract attention to yourself through showy or dramatic behaviour
example: His exhibitionism turned the quiet team lunch into a one-man show of loud stories and impressions.

hindi: विस्फोटक क्रोध — अचानक हिंसक रूप से भड़कने वाला
definition: having a temper that goes off suddenly and violently with little warning
example: The coach had an explosive temper and the players learned to spot the signs.

hindi: अतिसंवेदनशील रुचि वाला — ज़रा सी गंदगी से घिनाने वाला
definition: so demanding about cleanliness and detail that small imperfections provoke distaste and cannot be tolerated
example: He was fastidious about the shared kitchen and wiped down the counter twice before making his tea.

hindi: नियतिवादी — सब कुछ पहले से तय मानकर निष्क्रिय स्वीकार करने वाला
definition: a person who feels that events are fixed by fate and meets welcome and unwelcome news alike with resigned, passive acceptance
example: A fatalist about the layoffs, he stopped updating his resume and just waited for the email.

hindi: आत्मीयता का भय — किसी को पास आने देने से डरना
definition: anxiety about letting another person truly close, so that you keep affection at a safe distance to avoid being hurt
example: Years of fear of intimacy meant he had dated a lot but never once left a toothbrush at anyone's flat.

hindi: छूट जाने का डर — दूसरे कहीं बेहतर समय बिता रहे हैं, यह चिंता
definition: the restless worry that other people are having rewarding experiences without you, fed by seeing their photos and plans online
example: He had chosen a quiet night in, but the fear of missing out set in the moment the group's beach photos started appearing.

hindi: मन प्रफुल्लित करने वाला — हल्की, सुखद प्रसन्नता देने वाला
definition: designed to leave people cheerful, warm and comfortable, offering easy happiness without any troubling depth
example: The team picked a feel-good comedy for the office movie night after a rough quarter.

hindi: सहानुभूति की एकता — समान परिस्थिति में दूसरों के प्रति अपनापन
definition: a sympathetic sense of solidarity with people whose situation you share or understand from the inside
example: Stuck on the delayed platform together, the commuters developed a quiet fellow feeling and started sharing snacks.

hindi: लड़ो या भागो प्रतिक्रिया — खतरे में शरीर की तात्कालिक तैयारी
definition: the automatic surge of fear and adrenaline that readies the body to attack or run when danger is sensed, felt as a pounding heart and sharpened senses
example: The unexpected knock at midnight set off her fight-or-flight response and she was on her feet before she knew why.

hindi: चापलूसी — स्वार्थ से भरी झूठी या बढ़ी हुई प्रशंसा
definition: insincere or exaggerated praise offered to please someone and win their favour, admiration used as a tool
example: The flattery in his email about her leadership arrived one day before he asked for a raise.

hindi: उथला मज़ाक — गंभीर विषय के प्रति लापरवाह हल्कापन
definition: showing a careless, joking lightness about something that deserves respect or serious attention
example: She gave a flippant shrug about the deadline that made her manager go quiet.

hindi: इश्कबाज़ी — हल्के-फुल्के, चंचल ढंग से रोमानी रुचि दिखाना
definition: a light, playful show of romantic interest that is enjoyed for itself and may lead nowhere
example: Their flirtation over the office coffee machine had been going on for months without anyone asking anyone out.

hindi: धराशायी — आश्चर्य से निढाल
definition: so surprised or overwhelmed by something that you feel knocked flat and unable to respond
example: I was floored when the quiet guy from accounts turned out to be a former national chess champion.

hindi: त्यागा हुआ — हर किसी द्वारा छोड़ दिया गया
definition: utterly deserted and left without help, with a sense of being given up on by everyone who mattered
example: Waiting alone at the closed station after the last bus left, he felt forsaken by the whole city.

hindi: भ्रातृवत — भाइयों जैसा स्नेह और एकता
definition: marked by the warm loyalty and affection of brothers, a feeling of kinship among equals
example: The two rival shopkeepers greeted each other with fraternal hugs at the street festival.

hindi: बेरोकटोक — नियमों की चिंता बिना खुला और सहज
definition: relaxed and unconstrained by rules or plans, happily going where the moment takes you
example: The freewheeling road trip had no itinerary, only a car full of snacks.

hindi: भयावह — डराने वाला और बहुत बुरा
definition: causing fear or shock because it seems dreadful, alarming and deeply unpleasant to face
example: The frightful banging from the boiler room had everyone edging toward the exit.

hindi: जानबूझी शीतलता — नापसंदगी जताने के लिए ओढ़ी गई रूखी दूरी
definition: a deliberate coolness and reserve of manner toward someone, disapproval shown by withheld warmth
example: After the argument about the shared fridge, a froideur settled over the flat that lasted a full week.

hindi: मौज-मस्ती पसंद — हंसी-खेल में रमने वाला स्वभाव
definition: having a playful, lighthearted temperament that seeks out amusement and enjoyment and brightens whenever a good time is on offer
example: Their fun-loving flatmate had turned Tuesday nights into a standing board-game tournament.

hindi: हंगामा — किसी बात पर भड़का सामूहिक आक्रोश या उत्तेजना
definition: an outburst of excited or angry public feeling and uproar over something, quick to flare and quick to fade
example: The furore over the new logo filled the company chat for two days and was forgotten by Friday.

hindi: नुक़्ताचीनी करने वाला — छोटी-छोटी बातों पर बेचैन और चिंतित व्यक्ति
definition: a British informal name for a person who gets anxious and agitated over small details and unimportant matters
example: Her dad was a fusspot about the picnic blanket lying perfectly straight on the grass.

hindi: खीझ भरा — जो कड़वी झुंझलाहट पैदा करे
definition: causing bitter annoyance and humiliation, especially when the unfairness of a situation stings
example: It was galling to watch the intern present the slides she had built over the weekend.

hindi: काला हास्य — भयावह स्थिति में डर छिपाने वाला मज़ाक
definition: grim joking in the face of death or disaster, a way of managing fear and dread by laughing at what cannot be escaped
example: The night shift traded gallows humour over the coffee machine as the third ambulance of the hour pulled in.

hindi: मुँह खोले ताकना — आश्चर्य में स्तब्ध होकर देखना
definition: to stare with the mouth hanging open in amazement, shock or wonder at something unexpected
example: The tourists gaped at the size of the bill for two coffees and a croissant.

hindi: किसी को अपनी ही याद और समझ पर शक कराना — मानसिक छल
definition: to make someone doubt their own memory or sanity by repeatedly denying things that really happened
example: He tried to gaslight her about the missed dinner, insisting she had never mentioned it despite the message on her phone.

hindi: कर्मठता — बिना टाले उठकर काम शुरू करने की ऊर्जा
definition: cheerful practical energy and initiative that gets you started on things without waiting to be pushed or persuaded
example: The flat needed painting for months, and it took a Saturday of get-up-and-go from his flatmate to finally begin.

hindi: बड़बड़ाना — भय या घबराहट में तेज़ अर्थहीन बकना
definition: to speak rapidly and unintelligibly in a state of fear, shock or extreme nervousness
example: He was gibbering about spiders by the time we got him out of the garden shed.

hindi: व्यंग्य कसना — ताने से किसी को चुभाना
definition: to make a mocking, taunting remark meant to sting someone or belittle them in front of others
example: He gibed at his cousin's cooking until she stopped inviting him to dinner.

hindi: चिकनी-चुपड़ी — सतही और बिना ईमानदारी की सहज बोली
definition: speaking with a smooth, easy fluency that feels shallow and insincere, brushing past real feeling with ready phrases
example: His glib apology for the missed birthday made her angrier than the forgetting had.

hindi: उदास और निराश मिज़ाज — मन पर छाया अँधेरा
definition: sunk in a low, dark mood in which everything ahead looks bleak and hopeful thoughts cannot get through
example: He was gloomy all through dinner, convinced the interview had gone badly.

hindi: उकसाना — चुभती बातों से किसी को भड़काना
definition: to provoke someone deliberately with taunts or nagging until they react in anger or do something rash
example: His brother kept goading him about the lost match until he finally stormed out of the kitchen.

hindi: शोक-संतप्त — गहरे शोक से टूटा हुआ
definition: overwhelmed by intense grief after a death, so consumed by sorrow that ordinary life feels impossible
example: The grief-stricken family sat in the kitchen unable to decide who should answer the ringing phone.

hindi: अत्यंत दुःखद — गहरा शोक या पीड़ा देने वाला
definition: causing serious grief or suffering, a loss or hurt so heavy that it wounds deeply
example: Losing the family shop after forty years was a grievous blow to her father.

hindi: मुँह बनाना — दर्द, घृणा या असहमति का विकृत भाव
definition: to twist the face into an ugly expression of pain, disgust or strong disapproval
example: He grimaced at the first sip of the office coffee and quietly poured it away.

hindi: गिड़गिड़ाना — दीनता से क्षमा माँगना
definition: to plead for forgiveness in a humiliating, self-lowering manner, abandoning every scrap of dignity in order to be pardoned
example: She refused to grovel to the landlord over one late payment.

hindi: वीभत्स — घृणा और दहशत उत्पन्न करने वाला भयानक
definition: causing horror and revulsion through violent, bloody or repellent detail that turns the stomach
example: The gruesome crime report was not what she wanted to see on her phone over breakfast.

hindi: रूखी आवाज़ वाला — बाहर से कठोर पर भीतर से नरम हो सकने वाला
definition: rough and abrupt in voice and manner, sounding unfriendly even when the intention is kind
example: The gruff mechanic muttered that the repair was free and waved her out before she could thank him.

hindi: बड़बड़ाना — दबी आवाज़ में शिकायत करना
definition: to complain in a low, muttering, bad-tempered voice about something tiresome you have to endure
example: He grumbled about the early start all the way to the station.

hindi: सावधान और बंद — भावनाएँ छिपाकर रखने वाला
definition: careful not to reveal your feelings or information, keeping a protective wall up because you do not fully trust the listener
example: His answers in the exit interview were guarded, polite but giving nothing away that could be used later.

hindi: ठहाका लगाना — ज़ोर से खुलकर हँसना
definition: to burst out in a loud, hearty and unrestrained laugh that turns heads and cannot be politely swallowed
example: Dad guffawed from the kitchen when he finally understood the joke, and the whole house heard it.

hindi: अपराध-बोध से ग्रस्त — दोष के बोझ तले दबा
definition: weighed down and constantly preoccupied by guilt over something you did, so that the remorse colours everything you do afterwards
example: Guilt-ridden after the argument, she cooked his favourite dinner without a word.

hindi: अपराधबोध भरा आनंद — जिसमें मज़ा आए पर थोड़ी शर्म भी हो
definition: an enjoyment one keeps slightly hidden because it feels unworthy or embarrassing, its secrecy adding to the pleasure
example: Her guilty pleasure was watching reality dating shows on the train with her phone tilted away from the aisle.

hindi: घबराहट में थूक निगलना — डर से गला सूखना
definition: to swallow hard and audibly out of nervousness, fear or dread of what comes next
example: He gulped when the interviewer asked him to explain the gap in his résumé.

hindi: उमड़ता स्नेह — प्रशंसा और प्रेम को अतिशयोक्ति से बहा देने वाला
definition: pouring out affection or praise in an excessive, breathless flow that can seem insincere
example: Her gushing thank-you note ran to two pages for what had been a fairly ordinary birthday present.

hindi: अंतड़ियाँ मरोड़ देने वाला — अत्यंत पीड़ादायक और विदारक
definition: causing such intense anguish and distress that it feels like a physical twist deep in the stomach
example: Watching the footage of the families searching the rubble was gut-wrenching for everyone in the newsroom.

hindi: हिम्मती — जोखिम उठाकर बेधड़क साहस दिखाने वाला
definition: showing blunt everyday courage that takes a risk most people would quietly avoid
example: It was a gutsy move to tell the landlord we would leave unless the heating got fixed by Friday.

hindi: अतिनाटकीय — भावना को भद्दे ढंग से बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर दिखाना
definition: overacting a feeling so crudely and obviously that the display becomes almost comic
example: Her hammy gasp of shock at the surprise party fooled nobody.

hindi: मनमुटाव — झगड़े के बाद बची कड़वाहट
definition: lingering resentment or bitterness left behind after a quarrel or unfair treatment
example: They shook hands after the argument, but there were clearly hard feelings on both sides of the kitchen.

hindi: कठोर अनुभवी — कड़वे अनुभवों से सख्त और भावशून्य बना हुआ
definition: toughened and made cynical by a hard life, showing a flinty lack of sentiment and no surprise at bad news
example: The hard-bitten court reporter read the verdict without a flicker of emotion.

hindi: परेशान और हड़बड़ाया — लगातार मांगों से घिरा और तंग
definition: feeling hounded and worried by constant demands and interruptions that leave no room to breathe
example: The harried waiter kept promising our order was coming while three tables waved him over.

hindi: उद्दंड-लापरवाह — बेपरवाह, हड़बड़ी भरा और अनुशासनहीन
definition: reckless, hasty and disorganised, dashing about impulsively without care or planning
example: The harum-scarum way he packed meant his passport ended up in the kitchen drawer.

hindi: जल्दबाजी — बिना सोचे तेज़ी से करने की उतावली
definition: impatient quickness in acting, hurrying so much that care and judgement get left behind
example: In his haste to leave the office he sent the draft to the whole company instead of his manager.

hindi: अतीत से त्रस्त — यादों का साया
definition: persistently troubled by the memory of a wrong or a loss that keeps returning uninvited and will not allow you any rest
example: He was haunted by the joke he had made just before the news came.

hindi: हृदय-शांति — मन का गहरा सुकून और चैन
definition: peace of mind and quiet contentment of the heart, an old word for freedom from worry and heartache
example: Walking home along the canal each evening gave him a heartsease no meditation app had managed.

hindi: मानसिक जड़ता — मन की सुस्ती और भावहीन मंदता
definition: a state of mental dullness and lethargy in which thought and feeling both move slowly and heavily
example: The hebetude of the long hospital wait left him unable to focus even on the crossword.

hindi: सिहरन — किसी चीज़ से होने वाली अजीब, रेंगती हुई घबराहट
definition: a creeping, skin-crawling nervousness brought on by something that feels unpleasant or uncanny
example: The empty parking garage at midnight gave her the heebie-jeebies.

hindi: हुड़दंग — मस्ती भरी शरारत और हँसी
definition: boisterous, playful amusement and harmless mischief carried out together in a spirit of cheerful excitement
example: The high jinks in the group chat peaked when someone photoshopped the boss onto a horse.

hindi: अकड़ भरा — खुद को सबसे ऊपर मानने वाला
definition: arrogantly superior in manner, behaving as if your status places you above everyone in the room
example: He got very high-and-mighty about the parking space once his promotion was announced.

hindi: मनमानी करने वाला — दूसरों की राय को तुच्छ समझने वाला
definition: using authority in an arrogant, overbearing way that ignores other people's rights and opinions
example: The high-handed decision to cancel the team outing by email, without asking anyone, left the office fuming.

hindi: उमंग भरा — जोशीला, बेपरवाह और खुशमिज़ाज
definition: boisterously cheerful and energetic, full of playful spirit that is hard to keep in check
example: The high-spirited graduates chanted all the way down the train carriage on the way home.

hindi: हुड़दंग — शोरगुल भरी, बेपरवाह मस्ती और शरारतें
definition: boisterous, carefree fun and playful pranks, usually shared by a group in high spirits
example: The office hijinks on the last day before the holiday involved a lot of bubble wrap.

hindi: खोखलापन — अंदर से खाली और अर्थहीन महसूस होना
definition: an empty, numb feeling that success or company brings no real satisfaction, leaving you unfilled
example: The hollowness of the congratulations at the party made her want to leave early.

hindi: सम्मानित अनुभव — आदर मिलने का गर्वयुक्त सुख
definition: deeply pleased and humbly proud at being shown respect or trusted with something important, gratitude mixed with dignity
example: He felt genuinely honoured when the retiring engineer asked him to take over the codebase.

hindi: लत लगी — किसी चीज़ में इतनी रुचि कि छोड़ना मुश्किल
definition: so captivated and interested in something that stopping feels impossible and every spare moment returns to it
example: After two episodes she was hooked and cancelled her plans for the evening.

hindi: हो-हल्ला — किसी अवसर पर मचाया गया शोरगुल भरा उत्साह
definition: noisy, showy excitement and commotion around an event, cheerful and a little overdone, more fuss than the thing itself deserves
example: After all the hoopla over the new logo, most customers never noticed it had changed.

hindi: प्रेम-स्वप्नी — प्रेम को लेकर अत्यधिक भावुक और आदर्शवादी
definition: a person who idealises love and believes wholeheartedly in grand romance despite repeated disappointments
example: A hopeless romantic, she still expected flowers and handwritten letters in the age of dating apps.

hindi: धक्का-मुक्की वाली मस्ती — शोरगुल भरी, उग्र हँसी-ठिठोली
definition: rough, noisy, physical fooling around, playful shoving and wrestling done in high spirits
example: The coach stopped the horseplay in the changing room before someone got hurt.

hindi: अतिथिपरायण — मेहमानों का हार्दिक स्वागत करने वाला
definition: warmly welcoming towards guests and strangers, eager to feed and look after them
example: Our hospitable hosts insisted we stay for dinner even though we had only come to drop off a parcel.

hindi: दर्पपूर्ण — विनाश को न्योता देने वाला अहंकार
definition: showing an arrogant overconfidence so extreme that it invites a downfall, as though the person believes normal limits do not apply to them
example: Launching the untested feature to every customer on a Friday afternoon was a hubristic decision they regretted by Monday.

hindi: रसहीन-गंभीर — हँसी या हल्केपन का कोई स्थान न रखने वाला
definition: unable or unwilling to see anything funny, taking every remark with a heavy literal seriousness
example: The humourless compliance officer asked for the joke to be put in writing.

hindi: अटका हुआ — किसी पूर्व प्रेम से मन न हटना
definition: still preoccupied and emotionally stuck on a former partner or an unreturned crush long after it should have faded
example: Months after the breakup she was still hung up on him, checking whether he had watched her stories.

hindi: भावावेश — वक्ता या भीड़ को बहा ले जाने वाला जोश और उत्साह
definition: a surge of stirring emotional fervour and enthusiasm that carries a speaker or a crowd along together
example: By the final chorus the whole stadium was singing with such hwyl that the players stopped to listen.

hindi: प्रचार से उत्साहित — बढ़ी हुई उत्तेजित उम्मीद
definition: worked into excited anticipation, often through build-up or publicity, expectations climbing high before the thing arrives
example: The group chat was hyped for the trailer drop and counted down the last ten minutes.

hindi: अतिसक्रिय — असामान्य रूप से बेचैन और अत्यधिक चंचल
definition: unusually and restlessly active, with an excess of energy that makes it hard to sit still or concentrate for long
example: After two energy drinks he was hyperactive all afternoon, bouncing between desks with ideas.

hindi: अति-एकाग्रता — किसी एक चीज़ पर इतना ध्यान कि बाकी सब छूट जाए
definition: an intense state of absorption in one task or interest that blocks out everything else, including basic needs
example: Hyperfocus on the model kit meant he looked up and found it was three in the morning.

hindi: अति-संवेदनशील — मामूली बात पर आहत
definition: excessively sensitive to criticism, so that mild remarks feel like personal attacks
example: She became hypersensitive to jokes about her accent after the move.

hindi: रोगभ्रम — बिना कारण गंभीर बीमारी होने का लगातार डर
definition: a constant, anxious conviction that you have a serious illness despite there being no real evidence
example: His hypochondria turned every headache into an evening of searching symptoms online.

hindi: हल्का उन्माद — बढ़ी हुई ऊर्जा और उल्लास की अवस्था
definition: a milder clinical state of elevated mood and energy in which a person feels unusually confident, restless and productive
example: During her hypomania she started three side projects in a single weekend.

hindi: आदर्श मानना — किसी को उसकी खामियों के बिना पूर्ण समझना
definition: to regard someone or something as perfect while overlooking their faults and flaws
example: She idealized her old boss until she read the messages he sent the interns.

hindi: सहज जिज्ञासा — बिना किसी उद्देश्य की हल्की-फुल्की जानने की इच्छा
definition: a mild passing desire to know something with no real purpose or need behind it
example: Out of idle curiosity she looked up how much the house across the street had sold for.

hindi: निष्क्रियता — बिना काम के खाली बैठे रहने की अवस्था
definition: the state of doing nothing useful, whether from laziness or lack of anything to do, often with a faint restless guilt
example: A week of idleness between jobs left her oddly more tired than the job had.

hindi: असहज — आस-पास के लोगों के बीच बेचैन और बेमेल महसूस करना
definition: quietly uncomfortable and unable to relax because you feel out of place among the people around you
example: He stood ill at ease at the edge of the party, holding a drink he did not want.

hindi: दुर्भाव-भरा — स्वभाव से ही कटु और द्वेषी
definition: having a spiteful, unkind temperament that shows in mean remarks and a readiness to think badly of others
example: His ill-natured comment about her promotion soured the whole celebration lunch.

hindi: अधीरता — देरी पर बेचैन झुंझलाहट
definition: a restless irritation at having to wait or endure delay, anger that comes from wanting things now
example: The queue at the ticket machine crackled with impatience as the train pulled in.

hindi: अनधिकार-धृष्ट — जिसका हक नहीं वहाँ दखल देने वाली ढिठाई
definition: rude by overstepping your place, asking or saying something that is none of your business with a bold disrespect
example: Asking the new neighbour how much she earned was impertinent, and she said so.

hindi: असमर्थता की भावना — सक्रिय होकर कुछ न कर पाना
definition: the frustrated feeling of being unable to act or make any difference despite badly wanting to
example: He felt a deep impotence reading the news from home while stuck in a hotel room abroad.

hindi: ढिठाई — निडर बेअदबी और खुला अनादर
definition: bold, cocky disrespect that openly ignores the deference a person usually expects
example: The impudence of the trainee correcting the surgeon in front of the patient left the room silent.

hindi: अनिश्चय — मन में पक्की धारणा न बन पाना
definition: a lasting uncertainty in which no firm belief or decision will settle in the mind
example: She stayed in a state of incertitude about the move until the lease finally forced the question.

hindi: जिज्ञासाहीन — जानने या पूछने की कोई इच्छा न होना
definition: lacking any curiosity or wish to learn, letting questions pass without the slightest interest
example: He was strangely incurious about the new neighbours and never once asked where they had moved from.

hindi: अप्रतिष्ठा — सम्मान को ठेस पहुंचाने वाला व्यवहार
definition: a treatment or situation that wounds your dignity by making you feel degraded or disrespected
example: He suffered the indignity of having his badge rejected at the door of his own launch event.

hindi: अवर्णनीय — शब्दों से परे भावना
definition: too great, sacred or intense to be captured in words, however hard you try
example: Holding the newborn, he felt an ineffable tenderness he could not explain to the group chat.

hindi: हीनता की ग्रंथि — खुद को दूसरों से कम समझने की गहरी भावना
definition: a lasting sense of being less capable than others that colours how you take every comparison
example: His inferiority complex flared each time his brilliant younger sister mentioned her research.

hindi: अमानवीयता — क्रूर और भावहीन बर्ताव
definition: extreme cruelty or heartlessness that treats others as though their suffering does not count
example: The documentary showed the inhumanity of how the workers were housed.

hindi: अगम्य — जिसके चेहरे से भावना पढ़ी न जा सके
definition: impossible to read, giving no clue in the face or manner about what is being felt or thought
example: The buyer stayed inscrutable through the whole pitch and then bought the entire stock.

hindi: अंतर्मुखी — अकेले में ऊर्जा पाने वाला स्वभाव
definition: a temperament that finds energy in quiet time alone and feels drained rather than lifted by crowds and small talk
example: The introverted analyst did her best thinking on solo walks and dreaded the open-plan brainstorming sessions.

hindi: अवांछित विचार — बिना बुलाए मन में घुसने वाला परेशान करने वाला विचार
definition: an unwanted and often disturbing idea that pops into the mind uninvited, causing distress out of proportion to any real intent
example: The intrusive thought of dropping the tray of drinks flashed through her mind every time she walked past the boss's table.

hindi: अभ्यस्त करना — कठिनाई सहते-सहते उसका असर खो देना
definition: to harden someone through long exposure until hardship or unpleasantness no longer troubles them
example: Years of angry customer calls had inured him to shouting, and he barely blinked anymore.

hindi: पूर्वाग्रही — कड़वे अनुभव से बिगड़ी नज़र
definition: seeing things with bitter, distrustful prejudice because of past disappointment or resentment
example: After three failed startups he took a jaundiced view of every pitch that mentioned changing the world.

hindi: उमंग से खिला — उत्साह भरी प्रसन्नता
definition: delighted and enthusiastic about something, an American excitement with a bright, happy fizz to it
example: She was jazzed about the new espresso machine and made everyone a coffee.

hindi: ताना मारना — ऊँची आवाज़ में हँसकर अपमान करना
definition: to shout rude, mocking remarks at someone, showing scorn loudly and openly in front of others
example: A few fans jeered at the goalkeeper as he walked past the stand after the missed save.

hindi: मज़ाकिया — हर बात में हंसी और ठिठोली करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a playful person who is always cracking jokes and treats most situations as a chance for laughter
example: The office jokester renamed the printer and had everyone giggling through the Monday standup.

hindi: विलाप-गीत — मृतक के लिए ऊँचे स्वर में रोना और गाना
definition: a loud, wailing lament for the dead, and by extension any high, grief-stricken crying that carries raw sorrow
example: The keening of the widow at the memorial service silenced even the children in the back row.

hindi: उत्सुकता — किसी काम के लिए उत्साह भरी तीव्र इच्छा
definition: eager, enthusiastic wanting to do or have something, shown in how quickly you volunteer
example: Her keenness to start the new role showed when she read every onboarding document before day one.

hindi: तनावपूर्ण उत्तेजना — किसी घटना से पहले चढ़ा हुआ जोश
definition: tense and highly excited before something important, with nerves and energy wound tight and ready to release
example: He was so keyed up before the pitch that he rearranged the slides three times.

hindi: प्रेम की गुदगुदी — पसंद के इंसान के छोटे से इशारे पर उमड़ी सिहरन
definition: the giddy fluttery thrill of romantic excitement, butterflies at a crush's smallest gesture
example: A single heart reaction on her message set off a kilig that kept her grinning through the whole meeting.

hindi: सौम्य दयालुता — कोमल और सहृदय स्वभाव
definition: a gentle, warm-hearted quality of temperament that treats everyone with patient care, quieter and steadier than a single kind act
example: There was a kindliness in the old pharmacist that made customers linger at the counter.

hindi: विशाल हृदय — उदार और सहानुभूतिपूर्ण स्वभाव
definition: having a generous and sympathetic nature that forgives easily and gives readily
example: A largehearted teacher, he never held a bad week against any student.

hindi: कुदृष्टि डालना — भद्दी कामुक मुस्कान के साथ देखना
definition: to look at someone with an unpleasant, knowing smile that shows sexual or malicious interest
example: The client leered at the receptionist until her manager stepped in and took over the conversation.

hindi: जीवन-प्रेरक — जीने की उमंग और आस्था जगाने वाला
definition: renewing your gladness to be alive and your faith in people through hope, courage or kindness shown
example: The documentary about the village choir was so life-affirming that she booked singing lessons on the train home.

hindi: उन्मत्त प्रेमासक्ति — किसी के प्रति जुनूनी विचार और बदले में प्रेम पाने की तड़प
definition: an involuntary, obsessive state of romantic attraction marked by constant thoughts of the person and a craving for them to feel the same
example: He later recognised those months of checking her online status every hour as limerence rather than love.

hindi: अनिच्छुक — किसी काम को करने से मन का कतराना
definition: strongly unwilling and reluctant to do something, holding back because the prospect is unpleasant or distasteful
example: She was loath to reopen the argument, so she let the comment pass.

hindi: दीर्घ सहनशीलता — अन्याय या कष्ट को धीरज से देर तक चुपचाप सहना
definition: a rare, formal word for patient endurance of hardship or provocation over a long time without striking back or complaining
example: It took real longanimity to sit through six months of delayed payments without sending a single angry email.

hindi: तनाव ढीला करना — कसाव और औपचारिकता छोड़ सहज होना
definition: to become less tense, stiff or inhibited and behave in a more relaxed, easy way
example: A round of terrible karaoke made the whole department loosen up before the retreat.

hindi: अधिपति जैसा — रौब और घमंड से भरा
definition: behaving with the grand, commanding pride of someone who expects to be obeyed and served, treating others as inferiors
example: He waved a lordly hand at the barista and expected his usual order to appear without asking.

hindi: इज़्ज़त जाना — सबके सामने मान घट जाने की चोट
definition: the public damage to your standing and self-respect when others watch you fail, be corrected or back down
example: Admitting in the client call that the numbers were wrong felt like a serious loss of face for the sales lead.

hindi: स्नेह के भूखे — लंबे समय से प्रेम से वंचित
definition: aching for affection after going too long without warmth or tenderness, so that even small kindness feels overwhelming
example: The love-starved intern lit up when the manager remembered his name.

hindi: प्रेम-विह्वल — अचानक प्रेम में पड़कर बेसुध और विचलित हो जाना
definition: dazed and distracted by a sudden romantic attachment, as though love had knocked you off balance
example: The lovestruck intern kept missing his stop on the bus because he was replaying their conversation.

hindi: मैत्री-भाव — सबके सुख की कामना वाली कोमल करुणा
definition: a tender, unconditional goodwill and wish for the happiness of every living being
example: The meditation app asked her to extend loving-kindness even to the driver who cut her off.

hindi: मन उदास — हल्की और ठहरी हुई उदासी
definition: quietly dejected and lacking in cheerfulness, a mild sadness that dampens energy
example: She was low-spirited all week after the holiday plans fell through.

hindi: अधकचरा उत्साह — न पूरी रुचि न पूरा इनकार
definition: showing only mild and halfhearted interest or approval, without any real warmth or commitment
example: The client gave a lukewarm response to the redesign and asked for more time to think.

hindi: आक्रोश — इतना खिजाना कि आपा खोने लगे
definition: to irritate or enrage someone so intensely that they feel close to losing their reason or self-control
example: The dripping tap maddened him through the whole sleepless night.

hindi: आत्मपीड़न — स्वयं के कष्ट में सुख पाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the tendency to find pleasure or satisfaction in one's own suffering, humiliation, hardship or punishment
example: Signing up for a fourth marathon in a year looked like masochism to his friends.

hindi: उदासीन-बेमज़ा — न खुशी न दुख, बस फीकापन
definition: feeling flat and unenthusiastic, unable to care much either side, a shrugging indifference toward whatever is offered
example: He felt pretty meh about the sequel and left the cinema halfway through.

hindi: विषाद — गहरी, ठहरी हुई उदासी की दशा
definition: a deep, brooding sadness treated as a lasting condition of mind rather than a passing mood
example: The doctor's notes from the old asylum described her condition simply as melancholia.

hindi: नाटकीय भावुकता — छोटी बात पर बड़ा भावनात्मक प्रदर्शन
definition: showing feeling in an exaggerated theatrical way that treats a small trouble like a tragedy
example: He clutched his chest and called the broken printer a disaster, which everyone found a bit melodramatic.

hindi: रंगरलियाँ — हँसी-खुशी वाला जश्न
definition: cheerful festivity and lively amusement shared with others, especially with food, music, dancing and laughter
example: The merrymaking on the balcony went on long after the fireworks had finished.

hindi: सम्मोहित — किसी चीज़ के वश में मोहित
definition: held in a fascination so complete that you seem hypnotized, unable to look away or think of anything else
example: The interns were mesmerized by the way the robot arm folded each shirt without a single wasted movement.

hindi: हल्की नाराज़गी — मामूली बात पर रूठ जाना
definition: to annoy someone mildly so that they feel put out and slightly offended without being properly angry
example: She was a little miffed that the barista remembered everyone's order but hers.

hindi: दिमाग सुन्न करने वाला — इतना नीरस कि सोच ही थम जाए
definition: so extremely dull and repetitive that it seems to switch off the mind and leave you blank
example: Renaming four hundred files by hand was mind-numbing work that left her staring at the wall.

hindi: पुरुष-द्वेष — पुरुषों के प्रति नफ़रत और अवमानना
definition: hatred or deep contempt for men simply because they are men, the mirror image of misogyny and just as sweeping in its dislike
example: The podcast host was accused of misandry after a string of jokes about useless husbands.

hindi: किचकिच करना — परेशान होकर बार-बार शिकायत करना या परेशान करना
definition: to fuss, fret and complain in a persistent, bothersome way, or to pester someone with such fussing
example: Stop mithering about the parking and just enjoy the day out.

hindi: कुड़कुड़ाने वाला — निराशा में लगातार शिकवा करता व्यक्ति
definition: a British informal name for a person who complains gloomily and at length about everyday things
example: Our neighbour is such a moaner that even the sunshine gives her something to grumble about.

hindi: एकोन्माद — एक ही विचार पर उन्मत्त जुनून
definition: an extreme obsession with a single idea or subject that crowds out everything else
example: His monomania about the perfect coffee grind had taken over the kitchen counter.

hindi: एकरसता — बदलाव के बिना बार-बार वही होने की ऊब
definition: the tiring sameness of something that repeats without variation until it wears down interest and mood
example: The monotony of entering the same spreadsheet numbers every morning made him dread the commute.

hindi: उदासी में डूबे रहना — सुस्त होकर दुःख मनाना
definition: to drift about in a listless, sulky sadness, feeling sorry for oneself rather than doing anything
example: Instead of calling anyone he moped around the flat all weekend in the same hoodie.

hindi: नैतिक घृणा — अनैतिक आचरण से उपजी जुगुप्सा
definition: the revulsion people feel toward cheating, cruelty or betrayal, a psychology term for disgust triggered by wrong conduct rather than by dirt
example: The moral disgust in the room was obvious when the manager admitted he had read the staff's private messages.

hindi: नैतिक उत्थान — किसी की भलाई देखकर उठा गर्म, प्रेरक भाव
definition: psychology's term for the warm, uplifting feeling of witnessing a deed of kindness or goodness that makes you want to be better yourself
example: Watching a stranger pay for the old man's groceries gave her a flush of moral elevation that lasted all afternoon.

hindi: नैतिक आतंक — समाज में किसी खतरे को लेकर फैला अतिरंजित भय
definition: a wave of exaggerated public fear that some group or new habit threatens society's values, spread by headlines faster than by evidence
example: The moral panic over the new game had parents at the school gate swapping rumours none of them had checked.

hindi: मनोबल — किसी समूह का साझा उत्साह और आत्मविश्वास
definition: the shared level of confidence, hopefulness and enthusiasm in a group, which rises with good news and sinks with setbacks
example: Morale in the warehouse shot up when the new schedule finally gave everyone a full weekend.

hindi: विकृत जिज्ञासा — मृत्यु, दुर्घटना या भयावह चीज़ों को जानने की खिंचाव
definition: a fascination and desire to know about death, disaster or unpleasant things that one also finds disturbing
example: Morbid curiosity kept the whole office refreshing the news page about the train crash.

hindi: अत्यंत लज्जित — शर्म से गड़ जाना
definition: so deeply embarrassed that you wish you could disappear, usually after a public slip
example: She was mortified when her phone blared music during the funeral.

hindi: भावविभोर — किसी बात से मन गहराई से प्रभावित
definition: feeling a warm, tender swell of emotion in response to something kind, brave or beautiful, often with a lump in the throat
example: He was genuinely moved when the whole group chat chipped in for his vet bill without being asked.

hindi: दमखम — साहस, जोश और चुनौती का सामना करने की हिम्मत
definition: gutsy nerve and determination combined with energy, the boldness to take on a hard challenge
example: It took moxie to walk into the meeting and ask for a raise on his second week.

hindi: विद्रोही — अधिकार के विरुद्ध भड़कता सामूहिक रोष
definition: full of shared rebellious anger toward those in charge, ready to refuse orders together
