example: By the third unpaid overtime weekend the warehouse staff were openly mutinous.

hindi: धुंधला मन — नींद या बीमारी से सोच का अस्पष्ट होना
definition: having a blurred, fuzzy mind in which thoughts will not sharpen, often from illness or lack of sleep
example: She felt too muzzy after the night shift to trust herself with the spreadsheet.

hindi: रहस्य में उलझा — समझ न पाने से हैरान
definition: puzzled by something that seems mysterious or unexplainable, as if a trick is being played
example: The mystified neighbours could not work out how the cat kept getting into the locked garage.

hindi: साँस रोक देने वाला — घबराहट और तनाव से भरा रोमांच
definition: causing anxious tension and suspense so intense that you cannot relax until the outcome is known
example: The nail-biting final minutes of the match had the whole pub standing on the chairs.

hindi: लचर दब्बूपन — कमजोर और निर्णयहीन
definition: feeble, sentimental and lacking in backbone, unable to make a firm decision or take a firm stand
example: He was too namby-pamby to tell the plumber the invoice was wrong, so he simply paid it.

hindi: घिनौना और दुर्भावनापूर्ण — गंदा या कटु
definition: very unpleasant to the senses or spiteful in behaviour, a plain word that covers both a foul smell and a cruel remark
example: The argument in the comments turned nasty within minutes, and people began digging up old posts.

hindi: नकारवादी — हर नये विचार पर आपत्ति और असहमति जताने वाला
definition: a person who habitually objects to plans and ideas, meeting new proposals with negative, discouraging doubt
example: The naysayers said the podcast would never find listeners, but it hit ten thousand downloads.

hindi: घबराहट — किसी बड़े मौके से पहले की बेचैनी और कंपकंपी
definition: a temporary attack of nervous tension and unease before a test or performance, felt in the stomach and the hands
example: Her nerves got the better of her at the karaoke bar and she handed the microphone straight back.

hindi: सिमटकर टिकना — गरमाहट और सुरक्षा के लिए सटकर बैठना
definition: to settle in close and comfortably against someone or something, seeking warmth, safety and rest
example: The toddler nestled into her father's shoulder on the train and was asleep before the next stop.

hindi: चुभन भरी खीझ — किसी टिप्पणी से चिढ़ा हुआ
definition: irritated and slightly stung by a remark, an annoyance that pricks rather than burns
example: He looked nettled when his sister corrected his pronunciation in front of the guests.

hindi: जुनून में डूबना — किसी एक बात के बारे में लगातार बेचैनी से सोचना
definition: to think about one worry or desire so constantly that it crowds out everything else in the mind
example: She obsessed over the typo in the sent email long after the client had replied without noticing.

hindi: घूरना — कामुक रुचि से किसी को खुलेआम ताकना
definition: to stare at someone with obvious sexual interest, in a way that is rude and uncomfortable to receive
example: She moved seats on the train after noticing the man opposite continued to ogle her.

hindi: भव्य भावुकता — भावना का बड़ा, ऊँचे स्वर वाला प्रदर्शन
definition: expressing feeling on a grand sweeping scale with loud passionate gestures and voice
example: The argument over the parking space reached operatic levels of wailing and arm waving.

hindi: अड़ियल चिड़चिड़ापन — जिद्दी और झगड़ालू स्वभाव
definition: stubbornly bad-tempered and difficult to deal with, refusing to cooperate out of sheer contrariness
example: My grandfather gets ornery whenever anyone suggests he should stop driving at night.

hindi: अभिभूत — भय मिश्रित श्रद्धा से दबा हुआ
definition: so impressed by someone or something grand that you feel small, timid and unable to behave normally
example: The overawed junior barely spoke during lunch with the company's legendary designer.

hindi: दबंग — दूसरों को दबाकर अपनी चलाने वाला अहंकारी
definition: domineering and arrogant, pushing your own wishes onto others with a heavy insistence that ignores theirs
example: Her overbearing co-founder rewrote everyone's slides the night before the pitch.

hindi: बोझ से दबा — अपनी ताक़त से ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारियाँ ढोता
definition: weighed down by more duties or worries than a person can fairly carry, leaving a tired heaviness
example: The nurse looked overburdened, juggling twelve patients on a ward built for eight.

hindi: अति आत्मविश्वास — अपनी क्षमता या सफलता का ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भरोसा
definition: excessive trust in one's own ability or in a plan's success, which blinds a person to real risks
example: Overconfidence made him skip the backup, and the laptop died the night before the presentation.

hindi: अति-उत्सुक — इतनी उत्सुकता कि जल्दबाजी हो जाए
definition: so eager and keen to please or to start that you rush ahead and overdo it
example: The overeager intern answered every question in the meeting before the client had finished asking.

hindi: अतिसुरक्षात्मक — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा बचाने की चिंता
definition: guarding someone from harm so anxiously and constantly that the guarding itself begins to smother their freedom
example: The overprotective older brother insisted on driving his sister to the party and waiting outside in the car.

hindi: अति-थकान से चिड़चिड़ा — इतना थका कि आराम भी न आए
definition: so exhausted that you become restless, irritable and unable to settle or sleep, tiredness tipped past the point of rest
example: The overtired toddler screamed at the wrong-coloured cup, and honestly his overtired father understood.

hindi: अति-उत्साही — उत्साह में सीमा से आगे बढ़ जाना
definition: so enthusiastic and eager about a cause or task that you push too hard and go too far
example: An overzealous moderator deleted half the group chat over a mild joke.

hindi: क्रोध का दौरा — अचानक और तीव्र उन्माद
definition: a sudden violent fit of rage or other strong emotion that seizes a person briefly and completely
example: He flew into a paroxysm of rage when the laptop crashed before he had saved the file.

hindi: किशोर मोह — किसी पर तीव्र क्षणिक आकर्षण
definition: an intense, short-lived crush or infatuation, an informal word for the giddy attraction of a schoolgirl or schoolboy
example: She had a massive pash on the new geography teacher and drew his initials in every margin.

hindi: बिल्कुल बढ़िया — सब ठीक होने की हल्की खुशी
definition: feeling fine and content, an American expression meaning everything is going nicely, sometimes with a hint of irony
example: Everything was peachy until the printer jammed five minutes before the meeting.

hindi: साथियों का दबाव — समूह में स्वीकार्य रहने की मजबूरी
definition: the anxious pressure to do what your friends or equals are doing so as not to be excluded or judged by them
example: Peer pressure got her onto the karaoke stage when nothing else in the world could have.

hindi: पश्चात्तापी — गलती स्वीकार कर सुधरने को तैयार
definition: feeling genuine sorrow for a wrong and ready to make amends, with a humble, almost formal seriousness
example: He showed up penitent with coffee for the whole team after missing the standup.

hindi: दबा हुआ — भीतर रोकी गई भावना जो निकलने को बेचैन हो
definition: held in and building up inside without release, as with feelings or energy waiting to burst out
example: All his pent-up frustration came out the moment the printer jammed again.

hindi: उलझन — किसी पहेली से घिरे होने की बेचैन भावना
definition: a puzzled confusion that keeps working at a problem it cannot solve, mixed with mild worry
example: The new tax form left him in a state of perplexity for most of the evening.

hindi: भय से जड़ — इतना डरा हुआ कि हिल भी न सके
definition: so frightened that you freeze and cannot move or think, as though turned to stone
example: He was petrified when the lift stopped between floors and the lights went out.

hindi: क्षमाशील — रूठने या क्रोधित होने के बाद जल्दी मान जाने वाला
definition: easily calmed or soothed after being upset, with anger that fades quickly once the cause is addressed
example: Her boss was placable enough that a sincere apology ended the matter before lunch.

hindi: भावावेग से लहालोट होना — खुशी, हंसी या झुंझलाहट से मानो फट पड़ना
definition: to collapse or burst from overwhelming emotion, whether excitement, laughter or exasperation
example: I nearly plotzed when the concert tickets I had given up on finally showed up in my inbox.

hindi: गंभीर-अप्रसन्न — नकचढ़ी गंभीरता से हँसी को नामंज़ूर करने वाला
definition: wearing a prim disapproving expression, humourless and solemn in a slightly self-righteous way
example: The po-faced moderator removed the meme and reminded everyone of the channel rules.

hindi: भावहीन चेहरा — जानबूझकर कोई भावना न दिखाना
definition: deliberately showing no emotion in the face so that nobody can guess your reaction
example: She stayed poker-faced when they read out the offer so the other side could not tell how thrilled she was.

hindi: थककर चूर — पूरी तरह हांफता हुआ
definition: informally worn out and exhausted, often with a cheerful admission that you have run out of steam
example: Two hours at the trampoline park left the kids buzzing and the parents pooped.

hindi: छुट्टी के बाद की उदासी — लौटकर रोज़मर्रा में ढलने का दुख
definition: the low, deflated mood after a holiday ends and ordinary routine returns, sharpened by the contrast
example: The post-holiday blues hit on the first Monday back, when the inbox showed four hundred unread messages.

hindi: मुँह फुलाना — नाराज़गी में होंठ निकालकर रूठना
definition: to push out your lips in a sulky show of displeasure when you have not got your way
example: He pouted for the rest of the drive after being outvoted on the playlist.

hindi: पूर्वाग्रह — जाने बिना ही बना लिया गया विरोधी मत
definition: a settled dislike or unfair opinion formed about a person or group before knowing them, resistant to evidence
example: The landlord's prejudice against students showed the moment he saw their backpacks.

hindi: नैतिक-दंभी — अपनी नैतिकता पर अभिमान करता उपदेशक
definition: self-righteously proper and fussy about correct behaviour, looking down on others for small lapses
example: His priggish lecture about reply-all etiquette annoyed everyone more than the original email.

hindi: टालमटोल — काम को जानते हुए भी लगातार टालना
definition: the habit of putting off tasks you know you should begin, choosing small distractions over the discomfort of starting
example: Her procrastination reached new heights when she deep-cleaned the oven rather than open the tax form.

hindi: स्वामित्व-भाव वाला — किसी पर अपना हक़ जताने वाला
definition: showing a feeling of ownership over a person or project as though others need your permission to touch it
example: He put a proprietary hand on the back of her chair whenever another colleague came over to talk.

hindi: अतिसंकोची — यौन विषयों से आवश्यकता से अधिक शर्माने और घबराने वाला
definition: easily shocked by anything sexual and disapproving of it more than the situation calls for
example: She was too prudish to laugh at the joke and quietly left the kitchen instead.

hindi: उत्साह से भरा — किसी आने वाली चीज़ के लिए उमंग
definition: excited and mentally fired up for something coming, an American eagerness that is already leaning forward
example: The kids were psyched for the sleepover and had their bags packed by noon.

hindi: संतोष से गुनगुनाना — गहरी तृप्ति का सुर
definition: to express deep, sleepy contentment in a low, pleased voice, like a cat being stroked
example: She practically purred when the masseuse found the knot she had carried since the quarterly review.

hindi: अपमानजनक टिप्पणी — किसी को नीचा दिखाने वाला वाक्य
definition: a short cutting remark intended to humiliate someone and make them feel foolish
example: Her put-down about his spreadsheet skills landed in front of everyone on the call.

hindi: झगड़ालू — बात-बात पर लड़ने की आदत वाला
definition: inclined to pick fights and arguments, finding something to dispute in almost every exchange
example: Her quarrelsome flatmate turned even a chat about the washing-up into a row.

hindi: शांत करना — घबराए या रोते मन को धीरे से चुप और स्थिर करना
definition: to make an anxious or upset person gradually calmer and stiller, often by gentle words or a steadying presence
example: A few slow breaths and a hand on her shoulder quietened the panicking intern before the demo.

hindi: चुटकी लेना — तुरंत चतुर और मज़ेदार टिप्पणी करना
definition: to make a quick, clever, amusing remark on the spot, often to lighten a tense moment
example: When the lights went out mid-presentation she quipped that at least nobody could see the typos.

hindi: कामोत्तेजित — खुलकर यौन इच्छा से भरा हुआ
definition: feeling frankly sexual desire in the moment, used lightly and often about oneself
example: He joked in the group chat that the long weekend had left him bored and randy.

hindi: मज़ाक उड़ाना — दोस्ताना ढंग से खिल्ली उड़ाना
definition: to mock or heckle someone in a rowdy, good-natured way, ribbing them loudly about a mistake
example: The whole group chat razzed him for falling asleep during the film.

hindi: एकांतवासी — लोगों से कटकर रहने वाला
definition: habitually avoiding other people and preferring to stay shut away from society by temperament
example: The reclusive developer worked from a cabin and only surfaced online when a bug report mentioned his name.

hindi: शर्म से लाल — चेहरे पर झेंप
definition: visibly flushed with embarrassment or shame after being caught in a blunder, the feeling showing plainly on your face before you can hide it
example: Red-faced, she realised she had been muted for the entire presentation.

hindi: तरोताज़ा — आराम के बाद पुनः ऊर्जावान
definition: feeling renewed in energy and mood after rest, sleep or a welcome change of scene
example: One proper night's sleep and she came into the studio refreshed and ready.

hindi: नरम पड़ना — कठोरता या क्रोध छोड़ देना
definition: to soften from a hard or angry stance and become gentler, kinder or more forgiving
example: After a day of silence her father finally relented and texted her a smiley face.

hindi: यादें ताज़ा करना — पुराने सुखद दिनों को आनंद के साथ याद करना और सुनाना
definition: to talk or think fondly about pleasant experiences from the past, enjoying the memory itself
example: The group chat spent the whole evening reminiscing about the terrible flat they shared at university.

hindi: दमन — कष्टदायक भावनाओं को अचेतन में दबा देना
definition: the unconscious burying of painful memories or feelings so deep that you are no longer aware of them
example: The repression only cracked when a song in the taxi brought back a summer she had not thought about in twenty years.

hindi: विश्रामदायक — मन को शांति और आराम देने वाला
definition: bringing a quiet calm that lets a tired mind settle and recover its strength
example: The slow train through the countryside was the most restful hour of her week.

hindi: अस्थिर — बेचैनी के कारण एक जगह न टिक पाना
definition: unable to stay still or settle to anything because of an uneasy, unsatisfied feeling inside
example: She was restless all evening, opening the fridge, closing it, and wandering back to the window.

hindi: रूमानी बनाना — किसी चीज़ को वास्तविकता से अधिक आकर्षक और भावुक समझना
definition: to picture something as more beautiful and appealing than it actually turned out, forgetting the discomfort
example: He tended to romanticize the years in the basement studio, forgetting the damp.

hindi: जड़ें जमी होना — किसी जगह या समुदाय से गहरे जुड़ाव की भावना
definition: the secure grounded feeling of belonging firmly to a place or community that will not vanish
example: After years of moving, the small town gave her a rootedness she had not expected.

hindi: जड़हीन — कहीं भी अपना घर न लगना
definition: feeling that you belong nowhere, without a home place or community to anchor your sense of who you are
example: After ten years of moving for work he felt rootless, with a storage unit in one city and friends in none.

hindi: जोश भरने वाला — सुस्त मन को जगा कर उत्साहित करने वाला
definition: waking people up with a lively rush of enthusiasm and shared courage, the way a chant or a fast drumbeat does
example: After a rousing pep talk in the break room, the sales team actually looked forward to the Monday calls.

hindi: हादसे को देखने के लिए गर्दन मोड़ना — जिज्ञासा से घूरकर देखना
definition: to stare with curiosity at something such as an accident, often slowing down or turning around to keep looking
example: Traffic crawled for a mile because every driver slowed to rubberneck at the crumpled van.

hindi: थका-कमज़ोर — लगातार थकान से सुस्त और चिड़चिड़ा
definition: tired, low-spirited and slightly unwell from too much work and too little rest
example: He was feeling run down and snapped at the barista over a wrong order.

hindi: परपीड़न — दूसरों को कष्ट देने से मिलने वाला आनंद
definition: the enjoyment of causing pain or humiliation to others, as a source of pleasure in itself
example: There was a hint of sadism in the way he waited until the interview to reveal the bad news.

hindi: ढीला पड़ना — हौसले या ऊर्जा का नीचे झुक जाना
definition: to sink and lose energy or spirit, drooping downward as tiredness or discouragement pulls at you
example: Everyone's spirits sagged when the trainer announced there was a second afternoon session.

hindi: आशावान — भविष्य को लेकर खुशमिज़ाज भरोसा
definition: cheerfully confident that things will turn out well, even when the situation looks difficult
example: The coach stayed sanguine about the season despite losing the first three matches.

hindi: तृप्त — इच्छा पूरी होने के बाद पूरी तरह संतुष्ट
definition: calmly satisfied because a desire or appetite has been fully met and nothing more is wanted
example: After the long Sunday lunch they lay on the grass, sated and unwilling to move.

hindi: स्वाद लेना — किसी आनंद को धीरे-धीरे और पूरी तरह महसूस करना
definition: to enjoy something slowly and fully, drawing out the pleasure instead of rushing through it
example: He savored the first quiet coffee of the morning before opening his laptop.

hindi: बलि का बकरा बनाना — समूह का अपना दोष एक व्यक्ति पर डालना
definition: the group habit of pouring shared blame and resentment onto one person so that everyone else can feel innocent
example: The scapegoating of the intern after the outage let the senior engineers avoid awkward questions.

hindi: देखे जाने का भय — दूसरों की नज़रों से घबराहट
definition: an anxious fear of being looked at or stared at by other people, which makes crowded rooms feel unbearable
example: Her scopophobia made the open-plan office feel like a stage she could never step off.

hindi: दूसरे की शर्मिंदगी का एहसास — किसी और की अटपटी हरकत देखकर खुद झेंप जाना
definition: the squirming embarrassment you feel while watching someone else do something awkward, even though you were not involved
example: The secondhand embarrassment was unbearable when the presenter kept mispronouncing the client's name.

hindi: आत्म-स्वीकृति — अपनी कमियों के साथ खुद को अपनाना
definition: a settled peace with who you are, flaws included, without the constant pull of self-criticism
example: Therapy did not make him perfect, but it gave him a self-acceptance that quieted the harsh inner voice.

hindi: आत्मश्लाघा — खुद को बड़ा दिखाने की चेष्टा
definition: the act of making yourself seem more powerful, important or impressive than you are, usually through boasting or exaggerated claims
example: His presentation was pure self-aggrandizement, with every team win reframed as something he had personally delivered.

hindi: आत्मकेंद्रित — हर बात को अपने फायदे और सुविधा से देखना
definition: habitually treating your own needs and convenience as the point of every situation, weighing others only by how they affect you
example: It was self-centered of him to move the team dinner to suit his gym schedule without asking anyone.

hindi: आत्मसंयम — अपने आवेगों और भावों पर नियंत्रण
definition: the calm ability to hold back an impulse or strong feeling and act with steadiness instead
example: It took real self-control not to reply to the rude email the moment it landed.

hindi: आत्म-आलोचना — अपनी कमियों की कठोर समीक्षा
definition: the habit of judging your own work and behaviour harshly, noticing faults faster than merits
example: Her self-criticism was so sharp that she deleted a perfectly good draft three times.

hindi: आत्म-भ्रम — अपने बारे में सुखद झूठ पर विश्वास
definition: a comforting false belief about yourself or your situation that you cling to because the truth would hurt
example: Insisting the startup was fine while payroll bounced was self-delusion, and his cofounder said so.

hindi: आत्म-अनुशासन — मन न होते हुए भी नियमित प्रयास जारी रखना
definition: the steady ability to make yourself do what needs doing despite boredom, tiredness or temptation to stop
example: Her self-discipline showed in the way she opened the textbook every night even after a long shift.

hindi: आत्म-संदेह — अपनी योग्यता और निर्णयों पर भरोसा न होना
definition: an uneasy questioning of your own abilities and choices that undermines confidence before you have even tried
example: Self-doubt crept in halfway through the essay and he deleted three paragraphs that were perfectly fine.

hindi: आत्मगोपन — खुद को पीछे रखने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the habit of keeping yourself in the background and drawing attention away from your own contributions
example: His self-effacement was so complete that the client left believing the intern had designed the whole system.

hindi: आत्मघृणा — स्वयं से गहरी नफ़रत
definition: intense hatred and disgust directed at oneself, often after failing to live up to your own standards
example: After snapping at his daughter he lay awake in a fog of self-loathing, replaying every word.

hindi: आत्म-दया — अपनी ही हालत पर तरस
definition: excessive sorrow for one's own troubles, an unhappiness that turns inward and feeds on itself
example: After the breakup he spent a week in self-pity, replaying every unfair thing that had happened to him.

hindi: आत्मसंयमी — भावनाओं पर पूरा नियंत्रण रखने वाला
definition: calm, confident and fully in control of your feelings and reactions when others might flinch
example: The self-possessed intern answered the hostile question without a flicker of panic.

hindi: आत्म-दोषारोपण — बार-बार खुद को कोसना
definition: bitter, accusing blame directed at yourself for a wrong you cannot undo, harsher and more relentless than simple regret
example: After the launch failed he sank into self-recrimination for weeks.

hindi: स्वाभिमान — अपनी गरिमा बनाए रखने की भावना
definition: a quiet pride in your own dignity and standards that makes you refuse to be treated badly or to act beneath yourself
example: She kept her self-respect by declining the job offer once they mentioned unpaid weekend shifts.

hindi: आत्म-निग्रह — तीव्र इच्छा के बावजूद स्वयं को रोक लेना
definition: holding back an urge to speak, react or indulge, choosing composure even when the feeling pushing you is strong
example: It took real self-restraint not to correct his boss's wrong figures in front of the client.

hindi: आत्मधर्मी — अपने को नैतिक रूप से श्रेष्ठ मानने वाला
definition: smugly convinced that your own moral views are correct and that people who disagree are not merely mistaken but wicked
example: His self-righteous lecture about recycling went on so long that the rest of the kitchen quietly finished lunch and left.

hindi: आत्ममूल्य — अपने मूल्यवान होने का बोध
definition: the inner sense that you deserve respect and happiness regardless of what you achieve or what others think
example: Losing the contract dented his self-worth so badly that he stopped applying for anything for months.

hindi: वियोग चिंता — किसी प्रिय से दूर होने पर होने वाली घबराहट
definition: the distress and worry felt when parted from a person or place that gives a sense of safety
example: The puppy's separation anxiety meant it howled every time she left for the office.

hindi: स्थिर — बेचैनी के बाद मन का टिक जाना
definition: calmly established and secure after a period of unrest, with the restlessness gone and life feeling in place
example: Six months into the new city, she finally felt settled enough to hang pictures on the wall.

hindi: कांपता हुआ — घबराहट के कारण अस्थिर और कमज़ोर महसूस करना
definition: trembling and unsteady from nerves or shock, with a voice or hands that will not hold still
example: She felt shaky after the phone call and had to sit on the stairs before telling anyone the news.

hindi: तेज़ ज़बान वाला — कटु और चुभने वाले बोल बोलने वाला
definition: given to harsh, cutting speech that wounds people, often out of impatience or contempt rather than deliberate cruelty
example: The sharp-tongued editor could reduce a nervous intern to silence with a single question.

hindi: झेंपा हुआ — हल्की शर्म से मुस्कराता
definition: showing mild, slightly comic embarrassment about a small fault, often with a guilty half-smile
example: He gave a sheepish grin when the group chat noticed he had replied to himself.

hindi: तुनकमिज़ाज — जल्दी चिढ़कर बदतमीज़ हो जाना
definition: bad-tempered and rudely annoyed, especially in a huffy way when one feels wronged
example: He got shirty with the delivery driver over a five-minute delay.

hindi: कर्कशा — झगड़ालू और कटु स्वभाव की स्त्री
definition: an irritable, aggressively nagging woman who scolds constantly, an old-fashioned and unkind label
example: The sitcom's writers leaned on the tired cliché of the shrew who berates her husband at breakfast.

hindi: चीखना — भय या रोमांच में कर्कश तीखी चीख
definition: to utter a sudden piercing scream from terror, sharp pain or wild excitement
example: She shrieked when a spider dropped from the kitchen cupboard onto her arm.

hindi: मुँह खुला हुआ — आश्चर्य से जबड़ा लटका
definition: gaping with the mouth hanging open in dumb astonishment or stupefied wonder
example: The slack-jawed commuters watched a man carry a full-size fridge onto the train.

hindi: सुस्त — धीमा, भारी और ऊर्जा से खाली
definition: slow-moving and lacking energy or alertness, as if your body and thoughts were wading through something thick
example: After the heavy lunch the whole office turned sluggish and the afternoon meeting dragged.

hindi: चिकनी बनावटी शालीनता — झूठी गर्मजोशी
definition: showing warmth and friendliness in an oily insincere way that feels like flattery
example: The smarmy salesman kept calling her a genius for choosing the bigger plan.

hindi: दबा देना — किसी भावना को बाहर आने से ज़बरदस्ती रोकना
definition: to force a strong feeling down and out of sight, pressing back anger, grief or laughter so hard that it is almost extinguished
example: He smothered his disappointment and congratulated the colleague who got the promotion instead of him.

hindi: दबी हुई उपहास की हँसी — किसी की भूल पर छिपकर हँसना
definition: to laugh in a half-hidden, slightly mocking way at someone else's mistake or awkwardness
example: Someone snickered when the new guy tried to open the pull door by pushing it.

hindi: कुटिल-व्यंग्यपूर्ण — दबे तौर पर अपमान करने वाला
definition: mocking and spiteful in an indirect, sneaky way that lets the speaker deny meaning offence
example: Her snide remark about his second-hand shoes was delivered with a perfectly innocent smile.

hindi: सुबकना — रोते हुए या रोना रोकते हुए नाक से हल्की आवाज़ करना
definition: to sniff repeatedly and quietly while crying or trying to hold back tears
example: She sniffled through the whole wedding speech and blamed it on hay fever.

hindi: नाक सिकोड़ने वाला — हल्के तिरस्कार से अस्वीकृति दिखाना
definition: showing mild disdain, as if wrinkling your nose at something you consider not quite good enough
example: The sommelier was a bit sniffy when they ordered the cheapest bottle on the list.

hindi: दंभी — खुद को नीचे वालों से श्रेष्ठ मानकर तिरस्कार करने वाला
definition: a person who feels superior because of class, taste or wealth and looks down on those they consider inferior
example: The wine snob at dinner sniffed at the supermarket bottle before anyone had tasted it.

hindi: गंभीर कर देने वाला — हँसी उड़ा कर गहरी सोच में डालने वाला
definition: making you suddenly serious and thoughtful by revealing a hard truth, so that lighter moods drain away
example: Seeing the flood photos from his hometown was a sobering start to what had been a cheerful commute.

hindi: मृदुभाषी — धीमी, कोमल और शांत आवाज़ में बोलने वाला
definition: speaking in a gentle, quiet voice that suggests a calm and unaggressive nature, never raised even in disagreement
example: The soft-spoken mediator somehow got both shouting neighbours to lower their voices within minutes.

hindi: गंभीरता — गहरी और आदरपूर्ण गंभीरता का भाव
definition: a deep serious dignity that a moment or ceremony carries, calling for quiet respectful feeling
example: The solemnity of the minute's silence reached even the noisy corner of the trading floor.

hindi: गंभीर उदासी — शांत, गहरा और मंद
definition: serious and quietly sorrowful in mood, a dark, subdued feeling with no lightness in it
example: The group chat went sombre when someone shared the news about the accident.

hindi: मंत्रमुग्ध — जैसे जादू से बाँध दिया गया हो
definition: held completely still by fascination, as though a magic spell were stopping you from looking away
example: The whole carriage sat spellbound while the little girl sang to herself by the window.

hindi: निःशेष — ऊर्जा पूरी तरह खर्च हो चुकी
definition: having used up every reserve of energy and emotion, left empty and unable to give anything more
example: When the final exam ended she felt utterly spent and sat in the corridor for twenty minutes.

hindi: रोमांचक — रीढ़ में सिहरन पैदा करने वाला
definition: thrilling or frightening in a way that sends a shiver of excitement down your back
example: The choir's final note was spine-tingling even through the laptop speakers.

hindi: तेज़-मिज़ाज — गुस्से में तीखा और जोशीला व्यक्ति
definition: a person, often a woman, with a fiery, quick temper and a sharp tongue that others find both fierce and admirable
example: The new intern was a spitfire who argued back at the director in her first week.

hindi: हकबकाकर बोलना — आक्रोश या हैरानी में अटक-अटक कर बोलना
definition: to speak in a rapid, incoherent, spitting way because indignation or astonishment has left you flustered
example: She spluttered with outrage when the waiter assumed her son was paying.

hindi: आत्म-केंद्रित भ्रम — यह मान लेना कि सब आपकी हर गलती देख रहे हैं
definition: the tendency to believe that other people notice your appearance and mistakes far more than they actually do
example: The spotlight effect had him convinced the whole train was staring at the coffee stain on his shirt.

hindi: ठुकराना — घृणा या तिरस्कार के साथ अस्वीकार करना
definition: to reject an offer or a person with visible disdain, as though accepting would be beneath you
example: He spurned the apology and the flowers that came with it, leaving both on the doorstep overnight.

hindi: बेचैन-चंचल — घबराई हुई अस्थिरता
definition: restless, jumpy and unable to settle, an American word for a nervous energy that keeps you fidgeting
example: He got squirrelly waiting for the test results and kept refreshing his email.

hindi: कलफ़दार-औपचारिक — कड़ी औपचारिकता से भरा ठंडा व्यवहार
definition: stiffly formal and unbending in manner, correct to the point of coldness like a heavily starched collar
example: The starchy receptionist would not use first names even after a year.

hindi: हैसियत की चिंता — दूसरों की नज़र में अपनी जगह की फ़िक्र
definition: a persistent worry about where you stand compared with others in wealth, success or respect
example: The reunion invitation triggered status anxiety and a sudden urge to update his job title online.

hindi: फौलादी — कठोर और अडिग दृढ़ता वाला
definition: hard and cold in determination, showing no softness or sign of giving way, with a chill that warns others not to push
example: Her steely stare across the table ended the argument before it started.

hindi: टिके रहने की लगन — काम छोड़े बिना डटे रहने का गुण
definition: dogged persistence and perseverance, the homely virtue of keeping at a task until it is finished
example: It was plain stick-to-itiveness that got her through the driving test on the fourth attempt.

hindi: निस्तब्धता — भीतर की गहरी शांति और ठहराव
definition: a deep inner quiet in which restless thoughts stop moving and the mind rests without effort
example: Sitting on the balcony before anyone else woke, he felt a stillness he never found during the workday.

hindi: बनावटी कठोरता — असहजता से जकड़ी हुई बोली
definition: stiff and unnatural in manner, speaking with an awkward formality that reveals discomfort or self-consciousness
example: Their conversation at the reunion was stilted until someone mentioned the old school canteen.

hindi: चुभन — आलोचना से हुई तीखी पीड़ा
definition: the sharp, brief pain of an insult or criticism that lingers longer than it should
example: The sting of her comment stayed with him during the whole train ride.

hindi: उत्तेजक — मन में जोश और गौरव की लहर उठाने वाला
definition: rousing a proud, energetic surge of feeling that makes the chest swell, as a great speech or anthem does
example: The captain's stirring message before the product launch had even the quiet engineers cheering.

hindi: पत्थर-चेहरा — चेहरे पर कोई भाव न आने देने वाला कठोर
definition: showing no emotion at all on the face, deliberately blank and unmoved in a way that feels chilly
example: The stone-faced security guard did not blink at the child's knock-knock joke.

hindi: कठोर-नैतिक — नियमों और मर्यादा में बहुत सख्त और संकुचित
definition: strict and narrowly proper in morals and behaviour, restrained to the point of seeming prudish and unable to relax
example: The straitlaced accountant left the karaoke bar the moment the first rude song came on.

hindi: तनाव-कारक — मानसिक दबाव पैदा करने वाली चीज़
definition: anything, from a deadline to a noisy neighbour, that triggers strain and anxiety in a person
example: For him the biggest stressor was the weekly budget call with the client.

hindi: अड़ियल गुस्सा — झगड़ालू और असहयोगी
definition: bad-tempered and awkwardly argumentative, refusing to go along with things out of temper
example: The teenager went stroppy when asked to put his phone away at dinner.

hindi: तनाव से तना हुआ — थकान और घबराहट में खिंचा
definition: stretched to a nervous, exhausted tension by prolonged stress or lack of sleep, unable to settle
example: She was strung out after the week of deadlines and jumped when the phone rang.

hindi: सन्न — आश्चर्य से मूढ़ और निष्क्रिय
definition: dazed into numb silence by amazement or shock, with the mind seeming to stop working
example: The stupefied crowd stood motionless as the fireworks display went completely wrong.

hindi: दासवत विनम्रता — खुद को दूसरे से नीचे रखना
definition: too willing to obey and please others, treating your own wishes as less important than theirs
example: She hated how subservient she became around her father-in-law, laughing at jokes she found unfunny.

hindi: सहारा — संकट में दी गई सहायता और सांत्वना
definition: help and comfort given to someone in distress or hardship, the relief that reaches a person at their lowest point
example: After the flood, the neighbours brought food and succour to the family sleeping in the school hall.

hindi: रूखा और उजड्ड — बदमिज़ाज और अभद्र
definition: bad-tempered and rudely unfriendly in manner, answering people with a scowl rather than an insult
example: The surly waiter dropped the menus on the table without a word and walked away.

hindi: काम से लदा — इतने काम में डूबा कि साँस लेने की फुरसत न हो
definition: feeling buried under a flood of work or requests arriving faster than they can be cleared
example: He was so swamped with support tickets that he ate lunch standing at his desk.

hindi: चाटुकार — स्वार्थ से भरी खुशामद करने वाला
definition: flattering people in power with servile eagerness in order to gain advantage from them
example: The sycophantic replies under the CEO's post made the actual criticism impossible to find.

hindi: सहानुभूति-वेदना — दूसरे की पीड़ा देख अपने शरीर में महसूस हुआ दर्द
definition: aches or discomfort a person feels in their own body out of close fellow feeling for someone who is actually suffering
example: He swore he got sympathy pains every time his pregnant wife mentioned her back.

hindi: जीवन से विरक्ति — जीने की ऊब और थकान का गहरा भाव
definition: a weary disgust with life itself, in which nothing seems worth the effort of continuing
example: Halfway through another identical Monday, a taedium vitae settled on him that made even lunch feel pointless.

hindi: सामूहिक भावना — साथियों के प्रति एकजुटता और उत्साह
definition: a warm feeling of loyalty and shared enthusiasm among members of a group working together
example: The team spirit in the kitchen carried the staff through the busiest wedding of the summer.

hindi: आँसू भरा — भावुकता से रोने के कगार पर होना
definition: close to tears because of a tender or sorrowful feeling rather than sharp pain
example: She went a bit teary reading the goodbye card the whole office had signed.

hindi: स्वभाव — व्यक्ति की जन्मजात भावनात्मक प्रकृति
definition: a person's basic emotional nature, the settled pattern of how strongly and how quickly they feel things
example: Her calm temperament made her the obvious choice to handle angry customers.

hindi: कोमल स्नेह — आवेश नहीं बल्कि नरम इशारों में झलकता प्यार
definition: a soft tender fondness expressed in gentle gestures rather than in passion or grand words
example: The way he tucked a blanket over her on the train showed a tendresse that ten years of marriage had not worn thin.

hindi: फीका उत्साह — बिना गर्मजोशी की हल्की प्रतिक्रिया
definition: showing only a faint, unenthusiastic reaction where excitement or strong feeling was expected
example: The announcement of the new logo got tepid applause and a few polite nods.

hindi: मोटी चमड़ी वाला — आलोचना या अपमान से आसानी से आहत न होने वाला
definition: not easily hurt by criticism or insults, letting harsh words bounce off without much feeling
example: You have to be thick-skinned to read the comments section on your own articles every morning.

hindi: अतिसंवेदनशील — आलोचना से जल्दी आहत होने वाला
definition: easily hurt and offended by criticism, taking small remarks as personal attacks
example: The thin-skinned director sulked for a week over one lukewarm review.

hindi: नाराज़-चिढ़ा — तेज़ पर क्षणिक क्रोध
definition: sharply annoyed and angry at a specific slight or mistake, an American irritation that flares quickly and shows on your face
example: Dad was ticked off that nobody had told him the plans had changed.

hindi: गुदगुदाया हुआ — किसी छोटी बात से अचानक प्रसन्न और हँसता हुआ
definition: quietly delighted and amused by something small, pleased in a warm private way that makes you smile
example: Grandma was tickled that the kids had learned her old card game from a video online.

hindi: बेचैन-अधीर — घबराया हुआ और छटपटाता
definition: restless, nervous and impatient to get going, in Australian slang for someone who cannot keep still
example: The whole team was toey waiting for the results email to land.

hindi: अकड़ू-दंभी — ऊँचे वर्ग का घमंड
definition: snobbish and superior, looking down on people you consider common, a British word for stuck-up arrogance
example: The toffee-nosed couple at the next table complained that the wine list was too short.

hindi: भावहीन स्वर — बिना उतार-चढ़ाव की सुन्न आवाज़
definition: spoken without any rise or fall of feeling, a flat voice that suggests numbness, exhaustion or hidden distress
example: In a toneless voice he read out the list of redundancies to the assembled staff.

hindi: कठोर प्रेम — भलाई के लिए दिखाई गई सख़्ती
definition: affection expressed through firmness and refusal to indulge, choosing what helps someone over what soothes them
example: It was tough love when his sister refused to lend him money and instead drove him to the job centre.

hindi: अतिक्रमण — साधारण सीमाओं से ऊपर उठने का अनुभव
definition: the feeling of rising above ordinary limits and self, as if touching something larger and more lasting than daily life
example: For a moment on the empty morning train, the sunrise gave him a strange sense of transcendence.

hindi: स्थानांतरण — पुराने रिश्तों की भावनाओं को किसी नए व्यक्ति पर डाल देना
definition: the unconscious redirecting of feelings from a past relationship onto someone in the present, often a therapist or boss
example: The therapist gently pointed out the transference when he started calling her by his mother's name.

hindi: आनंदविभोर — आनंद में मानो कहीं और पहुँच जाना
definition: carried away by such intense delight or wonder that you seem to leave the present place entirely
example: She sat transported by the music, her coffee going cold on the kitchen counter.

hindi: आघात-बंधन — पीड़ा और स्नेह के चक्र से बना लगाव
definition: a powerful attachment to someone who alternates between hurting and comforting you, so the pain itself ties you closer
example: Her friends could not understand why she kept going back, but the trauma bond made leaving feel like grief.

hindi: ताना मारना — किसी गलती पर चिढ़ाना
definition: to taunt or tease someone about a blunder or weakness, poking at it to embarrass them
example: His sister twitted him about the burnt lasagne for the rest of the evening.

hindi: क्षमा न माँगने वाला — बेधड़क अडिग
definition: openly refusing to apologise for a choice, sometimes with pride, whether or not it was wrong
example: She was unapologetic about leaving the meeting early to collect her kid.

hindi: अनदेखा — प्रयासों की कद्र न होने का दुख
definition: hurt and resentful because your efforts pass unnoticed or unthanked by others
example: He felt unappreciated when the launch email never mentioned his team.

hindi: भारमुक्त — चिंता का बोझ उतर जाने का हल्कापन
definition: feeling calm and light after a heavy worry or secret has been set down and no longer weighs on the mind
example: After telling her parents the truth she walked home unburdened, lighter than she had felt in months.

hindi: औपचारिकता से मुक्त — खुला, सहज और बेतकल्लुफ
definition: relaxed and informal with the usual stiffness and formality dropped, easy, open and unreserved
example: After the client left, the meeting turned unbuttoned, with everyone kicking off their shoes and sharing snacks.

hindi: मौन-कठोर — बात करने या बताने से हठपूर्वक इनकार
definition: unwilling to talk or share information, keeping silent in a way that shuts other people out
example: After the argument he was uncommunicative for days, answering only with nods.

hindi: कम आँका हुआ — अपनी क़दर न मिलने की खटास
definition: feeling that your worth is rated far below what you actually contribute, a sore and resentful sense of being short-changed
example: Watching a newer colleague get the promotion left him feeling undervalued and quietly looking at other jobs.

hindi: अनुत्साही — बिना जोश या रुचि के
definition: showing little eagerness or interest, going along with something without any warmth or energy
example: The group chat gave an unenthusiastic thumbs up to the idea of another team-building day.

hindi: अथक — जिसका जोश या मेहनत कभी कम न पड़े
definition: keeping the same energy and enthusiasm all the way through without tiring or fading
example: His unflagging cheerfulness on the night shift kept the rest of the ward going.

hindi: अप्रभावित — दिखावे या दावे से कोई प्रशंसा न जगना
definition: feeling no admiration or wonder toward something presented as remarkable, meeting it with a flat shrug
example: The kids were unimpressed by the new office coffee machine and asked where the vending machine went.

hindi: विचलित करना — किसी का साहस और आत्मविश्वास छीन लेना
definition: to make someone lose their confidence and composure, leaving them shaken and uncertain
example: The silence on the call after her proposal completely unnerved her.

hindi: प्रतिक्रियाहीन — भावनात्मक संकेतों पर कोई जवाब न देने वाला
definition: not reacting to emotional signals or appeals from others, giving nothing back where a feeling was expected
example: She told him she was leaving and he stayed unresponsive, scrolling through the match scores.

hindi: अविचलित — किसी बात से परेशान या क्षुब्ध नहीं
definition: staying calm and smooth on the surface when something happens that would upset or annoy most people
example: The train conductor stayed unruffled as passengers complained about the third delay of the morning.

hindi: अरुचिकर और संदिग्ध — नैतिक रूप से गंदा लगने वाला
definition: disagreeable in a morally distasteful way, used of people, dealings or places that seem dishonest or seedy
example: The landlord had some unsavory friends who collected rent in cash and never gave receipts.

hindi: भावुकता से मुक्त — व्यावहारिक और कठोर यथार्थवादी
definition: not swayed by tender feelings or nostalgia, dealing with things practically even when they carry emotional weight
example: She was unsentimental about the old house and had it on the market a week after the funeral.

hindi: अशांत कर देना — मन की शांति भंग कर बेचैनी भर देना
definition: to disturb someone's calm and leave them feeling uneasy and off balance without a clear threat
example: The empty desk next to hers, cleared overnight with no announcement, unsettled everyone on the floor.

hindi: निश्चिंत — चिंता या व्याकुलता से पूरी तरह मुक्त
definition: free from worry or inner disturbance, with a mind that carries no nagging concern about anything
example: She slept untroubled the night before the exam because she had studied everything she could.

hindi: शेखी बघारना — अपनी बड़ाई का बखान करना
definition: to boast about or praise something of your own excessively, in a proud and often formal way
example: The company vaunted its new office so loudly that visitors were surprised to find an ordinary open-plan floor.

hindi: परोक्ष अनुभूत — दूसरे के अनुभव से स्वयं महसूस की गई भावना
definition: felt through imagining or watching someone else's experience rather than living it yourself, such as borrowed pride or thrill
example: She got a vicarious thrill from watching her cousin's marathon finish on the live stream at work.

hindi: ओज — शरीर और मन की सशक्त, फुर्तीली ऊर्जा
definition: robust physical and mental energy that makes effort feel easy, a healthy forceful strength you bring to whatever you tackle
example: After a week off she came back to the office with a vigour that cleared the backlog by Wednesday.

hindi: सही सिद्ध होना — निर्दोष या सही ठहराए जाने की तसल्ली
definition: the satisfied relief of being proved right after others doubted, blamed or dismissed you
example: When the audit backed her numbers she felt a quiet vindication across the meeting table.

hindi: खट्टा-चिड़चिड़ा — सिरके जैसी कड़वाहट से भरा स्वभाव
definition: sour and sharp-tempered in manner, a peevish acid disposition that turns every remark slightly bitter
example: The vinegary landlord answered the door already complaining about the noise.

hindi: तेज़ाबी कटुता — जलाने वाली कटु आलोचना
definition: cruel and bitter criticism or anger expressed in words meant to burn like acid
example: The comments section filled with vitriol within minutes of the article going live.

hindi: चीत्कार करना — दुःख में ऊँची आवाज़ में रोना
definition: to weep loudly with a long, high, drawn-out sound of grief or pain, crying out in raw distress
example: The toddler wailed on the train platform when the balloon slipped away.

hindi: युद्धोन्माद — लड़ाई के लिए भीड़ का उग्र उत्साह
definition: the feverish, aggressive excitement that grips a population eager for conflict, sweeping doubt aside
example: The rival firm's leaked memo stirred a war fever in the sales team that lasted the whole quarter.

hindi: घुटने काँपती कायरता — दबाव में तुरंत झुक जाना
definition: giving way easily under pressure because of timidity, folding the moment things get uncomfortable
example: The landlord counted on weak-kneed tenants who would pay the extra fee rather than argue.

hindi: सुसमायोजित — मानसिक रूप से संतुलित और जीवन से सहज तालमेल रखने वाला
definition: emotionally balanced and comfortable with yourself and ordinary life, meeting setbacks with steadiness rather than anxiety or anger
example: For someone who had moved schools six times, he turned out remarkably well-adjusted and easy to be around.

hindi: सुभावित — किसी के प्रति अनुकूल और सद्भावपूर्ण
definition: feeling friendly goodwill toward someone and inclined to help or think well of them before they have earned it
example: The new landlord seemed well-disposed toward us, waving away the late fee with a smile.

hindi: तीखा करना — इच्छा या जिज्ञासा को बढ़ाना
definition: to sharpen someone's appetite or curiosity, stirring a desire for more with a small taste of what is coming
example: The two-minute trailer whetted the whole office's appetite for the season finale.

hindi: मुट्ठी भींच देने वाला — डर और रोमांच से जकड़ लेने वाला
definition: so frightening and thrilling that you grip the nearest thing tightly, tense with fearful excitement
example: The taxi ride through the storm was a white-knuckle experience neither of them mentioned to the client.

hindi: हर्ष से चीखना — खुशी में ज़ोर से पुकारना
definition: to give a loud, sudden shout of excitement and delight, often with the arms thrown up in triumph
example: The whole carriage whooped when the driver announced the delay was cancelled.

hindi: आँखें फैलाए — आश्चर्य या भोलेपन से चकित
definition: showing innocent wonder or surprise with eyes opened wide, often from inexperience
example: The wide-eyed new hire followed the tour of the studio without saying a word.

hindi: मुरझाना — उत्साह और ऊर्जा का धीरे-धीरे झुक जाना
definition: to lose energy and confidence and droop visibly, like a plant going limp, usually under heat, pressure or sheer tiredness
example: The presenter wilted under the third round of hostile questions and let her colleague take over.

hindi: डरपोक दुर्बलता — छोटी असुविधा से भी घबराना
definition: feebly timid and unwilling to face even mild discomfort, danger or risk, in a way that invites gentle mockery
example: He felt wimpy asking a friend to come along just to return the faulty phone to the shop.

hindi: सर्दियों की उदासी — छोटे अँधेरे दिनों में आई सुस्ती
definition: the mild sluggish sadness many people feel during the dark months of the year, lifting when the days lengthen
example: By January the winter blues had her hitting snooze four times and eating lunch under the office lamp.

hindi: हिमशीत — शीत ऋतु जैसी ठंडी और बेरुखी मुस्कान या नज़र
definition: cold and unfriendly in expression, a smile or look with the chill of a winter morning in it
example: He gave the latecomer a wintry smile and carried on with the presentation.

hindi: ढुलमुल — किसी पक्ष में पक्का न रहने वाला
definition: feeble and indecisive, unable to hold a firm opinion or commit to a clear course
example: The wishy-washy reply about the deadline left the client guessing whether it had moved.

hindi: हाज़िरजवाबी — चतुर, तीखे और मनोरंजक शब्दों की क्षमता
definition: the quick, clever ability to say amusing things, humour that comes from sharp intelligence rather than silliness
example: His wit kept the long car journey bearable when the radio gave out.

hindi: काठ-सा भावहीन — कठोर और नीरस अभिव्यक्ति
definition: stiff and lacking natural feeling in expression or manner, as if the emotion were being read from a card
example: His wooden delivery of the toast made it hard to tell whether he liked the groom at all.

hindi: काम का व्यसनी — काम से दूर रहने पर बेचैन होने वाला
definition: a person compulsively driven to keep working, who feels restless or guilty when not busy, so that work crowds out rest and relationships
example: The office workaholic answered emails from the delivery room while his wife was in labour.

hindi: चिंतालु व्यक्ति — जो हर बात पर बेवजह घबराता रहता है
definition: a person who worries constantly about things that are unlikely to happen, finding a fresh concern the moment the last one passes
example: The group chat's resident worrywart asked whether anyone had checked the weather for a picnic three weeks away.

hindi: अभागा और व्यथित — हताश और दयनीय दुःख में
definition: feeling miserable and worthless at the same time, unhappiness mixed with a sense of being pitiable
example: After snapping at his mother he felt wretched for the rest of the evening.

hindi: तड़पना — पीड़ा या लज्जा में शरीर ऐंठना
definition: to twist and struggle with the whole body in intense pain or mental agony
example: She writhed with embarrassment as the video of her karaoke went round the office.

hindi: अन्याय-पीड़ित — जिसके साथ गलत हुआ हो, उसकी भावना
definition: feeling that an injustice has been done to you and carrying that sense of unfair treatment around
example: He walked out of the meeting looking wronged, certain the credit for the project had gone to the wrong person.

hindi: बकबक करना — शिकायती स्वर में लगातार ऊँची बात करना
definition: to talk loudly and continuously in a complaining or whining tone that is hard to listen to
example: The passengers yammered about the delay until the driver turned the radio up.

hindi: अटपटा-मज़ेदार — बेतुका और पागलपन भरा हास्य
definition: amusingly crazy and unconventional, funny because of wild, absurd unpredictability
example: The zany energy of the improv night left everyone hoarse from laughing.
